# account.balance

An account's balance on a day: its own ledger lines and those of every account under it.

**Who may call:** the owner of its account.company.

**Budget:** p95 300ms.

## Payload

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| account | account.id |  |
| onDay | Day | The last day counted: lines posted on it count. |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| account | account.id |
| debit | Amount |
| credit | Amount |
| balance | Balance |

## Steps

- `account.balance.sum` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its account.company; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### keep the books

Starts from the world `a chart`.

- **Bank's balance at the year's end: 10,000 in, 1,500 out.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's bank, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [the world's bank, `10000000000`, `1500000000`, `8500000000`].
- **Assets, the group above it, holds the same.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's assets, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [the world's assets, `10000000000`, `1500000000`, `8500000000`].
- **Expenses, two groups above Rent, holds the rent.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's expenses, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`1500000000`, `0`, `1500000000`].
- **and so does Operating Expenses, between them.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's operating, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`1500000000`, `0`, `1500000000`].
- **Capital Stock is in credit, so its balance is negative.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's capital, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `10000000000`, `-10000000000`].
- **and Equity above it the same.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's equity, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `10000000000`, `-10000000000`].
- **Assets now holds both its ledgers, read again after the new one was added.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's assets, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`10200000000`, `1500000000`, `8700000000`].
- **Assets on 14 January, before any entry, holds nothing: the day limit holds below the group too.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's assets, onDay `2026-01-14`, and gets back [`0`, `0`, `0`].
- **Expenses on 31 January, before the rent, holds nothing.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's expenses, onDay `2026-01-31`, and gets back [`0`, `0`, `0`].
- **Bank on the rent's own day counts the rent.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's bank, onDay `2026-02-01`, and gets back [`10000000000`, `1500000000`, `8500000000`].
- **the day before, it doesn't.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's bank, onDay `2026-01-31`, and gets back [`10000000000`, `0`, `10000000000`].
- **on the capital's own day it counts the capital.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's bank, onDay `2026-01-15`, and gets back [`10000000000`, `0`, `10000000000`].
- **and the day before that, nothing.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's bank, onDay `2026-01-14`, and gets back [`0`, `0`, `0`].
- **Bank's balance is the capital alone again.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's bank, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`10000000000`, `0`, `10000000000`].
- **Assets holds the capital in both its ledgers.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's assets, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`10200000000`, `0`, `10200000000`].
- **Expenses holds nothing.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's expenses, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `0`, `0`].
- **and Capital Stock keeps the capital the cancel left alone.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's capital, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `10200000000`, `-10200000000`].

### pay a month

Starts from the world `a pension component`.

- **Salaries holds the month's pay.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's salaries, onDay `2026-03-31`, and gets back [`7000000000`, `0`, `7000000000`].
- **not the day before.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's salaries, onDay `2026-03-30`, and gets back [`0`, `0`, `0`].
- **Expenses, two groups above, holds it too.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's expenses, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`7000000000`, `0`, `7000000000`].
- **Pension Payable owes the pension.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's pension, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `300000000`, `-300000000`].
- **Payroll Payable owes the net pay.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's payable, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `6700000000`, `-6700000000`].
- **Liabilities owes both.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's liabilities, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `7000000000`, `-7000000000`].

### post a journal entry

Starts from the world `a capital entry`.

- **nor its balance.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends account the world's bank, onDay `2026-12-31`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Bank's balance is the capital.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's bank, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`10000000000`, `0`, `10000000000`].
- **Bank's balance is nothing again.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's bank, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `0`, `0`].
- **and Capital Stock's.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's capital, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `0`, `0`].
- **Bank's balance at 2026's end counts both, and not the cancelled entries or 2027's rent.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's bank, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `150000000`, `-150000000`].
- **at 2027's end it counts 2027's rent too.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's bank, onDay `2027-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `200000000`, `-200000000`].
- **Expenses, two groups above Rent, the same the other way.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's expenses, onDay `2027-12-31`, and gets back [`200000000`, `0`, `200000000`].
- **Assets, above Bank, too.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's assets, onDay `2027-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `200000000`, `-200000000`].
- **Equity, whose only lines were cancelled, holds nothing.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's equity, onDay `2027-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `0`, `0`].

### post a payment entry

Starts from the world `a received advance`.

- **Bank's balance is the advance.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's bank, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`500000000`, `0`, `500000000`].
- **Debtors' is the advance owed back, negative.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's debtors, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `500000000`, `-500000000`].
- **and Assets, which holds both, nets to nothing.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's assets, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`500000000`, `500000000`, `0`].
- **and Bank's.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's bank, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `0`, `0`].
- **and Debtors'.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's debtors, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `0`, `0`].
- **Liabilities, above Creditors, holds it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's liabilities, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`200000000`, `0`, `200000000`].
- **Bank is 200 USDC down.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's bank, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `200000000`, `-200000000`].
- **while Debtors holds both.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's debtors, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`100000000`, `70000000`, `30000000`].
- **while Creditors holds both.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's creditors, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`270000000`, `50000000`, `220000000`].

### run a payroll

Starts from the world `an outside cost center`.

- **Salaries holds February, Olga's March and April: E's slips aren't booked yet.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's salaries, onDay `2026-04-30`, and gets back [`19000000000`, `0`, `19000000000`].
- **Pension Payable owes 600.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's pension, onDay `2026-04-30`, and gets back [`0`, `600000000`, `-600000000`].
- **Payroll Payable owes 18,400.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's payable, onDay `2026-04-30`, and gets back [`0`, `18400000000`, `-18400000000`].
- **and 6,700 the day before April's.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's payable, onDay `2026-04-29`, and gets back [`0`, `6700000000`, `-6700000000`].

## How to call

```sh
capxul account balance --account <account> --onDay <onDay>
```

HTTP: `POST /account/balance` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.account.balance(payload)`.

# account.create

Add an account to a company's chart, under a group or as a root.

**Who may call:** the owner of its company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 150ms.

## Payload

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| company | account.company |  |
| accountName | account.accountName |  |
| parentAccount (optional) | account.parentAccount |  |
| isGroup | YesNo | Make it a group, which other accounts sit under, rather than a ledger, which takes entries. |
| rootType (optional) | account.rootType |  |
| accountType (optional) | account.accountType |  |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| account | account.id |
| rootType | account.rootType |
| reportType | account.reportType |

## Move

`create`: from nothing (it creates) to group or ledger, emitting AccountCreated.

## Steps

- `account.create.load` (database)
- `account.create.insert` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| ParentAccountNotInCompany | 41 | AC-001 | declared in errors.ts |
| ParentAccountIsLedger | 42 | AC-002 | declared in errors.ts |
| RootAccountIsLedger | 43 | AC-003 | declared in errors.ts |
| RootTypeMissing | 44 | AC-004 | declared in errors.ts |
| RootTypeNotParents | 45 | AC-005 | declared in errors.ts, carrying rootType |
| AccountNameTaken | 47 | AC-007 | another account holds this company and account name; by the rule account.oneNamePerCompany |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its company; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### assign salary structures

Starts from the world `a payroll outsider`.

- **Ada starts Acme Logistics' chart with a root group.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, accountName `Expenses`, isGroup true, rootType `Expense`, and is answered.
- **and a ledger under it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, accountName `Wages`, parentAccount the last call's account, isGroup false, and is answered.

### draft a journal entry

Starts from the world `a fiscal year`.

- **Ada adds Acme Logistics' Assets group.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, accountName `Assets`, isGroup true, rootType `Asset`, and gets back an answer matching `^acc_`.
- **and its Bank ledger under it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, accountName `Bank`, parentAccount the last call's account, isGroup false, accountType `Bank`, and gets back an answer matching `^acc_`.

### keep the books

Starts from the world `a chart`.

- **Ada adds a second ledger under Assets, beside Bank.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Float`, parentAccount the world's assets, isGroup false, and gets back an answer matching `^acc_[0-9a-z]+$`.

### run a payroll

Starts from the world `an outside cost center`.

- **Ada adds another ledger under Liabilities, typed as owed to suppliers.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Trade Creditors`, parentAccount the world's liabilities, isGroup false, accountType `Payable`, and is answered.
- **Ada adds a group under Liabilities, typed as owed to suppliers.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Accrued Liabilities`, parentAccount the world's liabilities, isGroup true, accountType `Payable`, and is answered.

### set up a chart of accounts

Starts from the world `a chart`.

- **nor add an account to Acme Trading's chart.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Cash`, parentAccount the world's assets, isGroup false, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Ada adds Cash under Assets, of the type Cash, naming no root type: it takes Asset.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Cash`, parentAccount the world's assets, isGroup false, accountType `Cash`, and gets back an answer matching `^acc_[0-9a-z]+$` and gets back [`Asset`, `Balance Sheet`].
- **a root group of the root type Liability is on the Balance Sheet.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Liabilities`, isGroup true, rootType `Liability`, and gets back [`Liability`, `Balance Sheet`].
- **a Payable ledger under it carries Liability.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Creditors`, parentAccount the last call's account, isGroup false, accountType `Payable`, and gets back [`Liability`, `Balance Sheet`].
- **an Income root group is in Profit and Loss.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Income`, isGroup true, rootType `Income`, and gets back [`Income`, `Profit and Loss`].
- **a child may name its parent's root type: a Tax ledger beside Rent, Expense.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Utilities`, parentAccount the world's operating, isGroup false, rootType `Expense`, accountType `Tax`, and gets back [`Expense`, `Profit and Loss`].
- **a child under Equity carries Equity, on the Balance Sheet.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Retained Earnings`, parentAccount the world's equity, isGroup false, and gets back [`Equity`, `Balance Sheet`].
- **an account under a ledger is refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Petty Cash`, parentAccount the world's bank, isGroup false, and is refused with ParentAccountIsLedger, AC-002.
- **and so is a group under one, naming another root type: the parent is judged first.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Petty Cash`, parentAccount the world's rent, isGroup true, rootType `Income`, and is refused with ParentAccountIsLedger, AC-002.
- **a root that isn't a group is refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Suspense`, isGroup false, rootType `Asset`, and is refused with RootAccountIsLedger, AC-003.
- **even with no root type: its being a ledger is judged first.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Suspense`, isGroup false, and is refused with RootAccountIsLedger, AC-003.
- **a root group must name its root type.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Suspense`, isGroup true, and is refused with RootTypeMissing, AC-004.
- **a child naming another root type than its parent's is refused, carrying the parent's.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Loans`, parentAccount the world's assets, isGroup false, rootType `Liability`, and is refused with RootTypeNotParents, AC-005, carrying rootType `Asset`.
- **two levels down too: under Rent's group it carries Expense.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Sales`, parentAccount the world's operating, isGroup true, rootType `Income`, and is refused with RootTypeNotParents, AC-005, carrying rootType `Expense`.
- **a second Bank is refused, under any parent.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Bank`, parentAccount the world's equity, isGroup false, and is refused with AccountNameTaken, AC-007.
- **and at the root.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Rent`, isGroup true, rootType `Expense`, and is refused with AccountNameTaken, AC-007.
- **a taken name under a ledger is refused for the ledger first.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Cash`, parentAccount the world's bank, isGroup false, and is refused with ParentAccountIsLedger, AC-002.
- **Ada starts Acme Logistics' chart with its own Assets: the name is that company's to use.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, accountName `Assets`, isGroup true, rootType `Asset`, and gets back [`Asset`, `Balance Sheet`].
- **an Acme Trading account under Acme Logistics' Assets is refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Float`, parentAccount the last call's account, isGroup false, and is refused with ParentAccountNotInCompany, AC-001.
- **Acme Logistics adds its own Bank under it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, accountName `Bank`, parentAccount the last call's account, isGroup false, accountType `Bank`, and gets back `Asset`.
- **an Acme Trading account under that ledger, naming another root type, is refused for the company first.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Float`, parentAccount the last call's account, isGroup false, rootType `Income`, and is refused with ParentAccountNotInCompany, AC-001.
- **Ada adds an empty group under Assets.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, accountName `Prepayments`, parentAccount the world's assets, isGroup true, and is answered.

### appraise a year

Starts from the world `a second feedback criteria`.

- **Cy's is still a draft, so FY 2027 can't be completed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisalCycle the last call's appraisalCycle, and is refused with AppraisalsNotSubmitted, CY-007.
- **and completes FY 2027.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisalCycle the last call's appraisalCycle, and is answered.

### give performance feedback

Starts from the world `a manual cycle draft`.

- **and completes H1 2027.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisalCycle the world's manualCycle, and gets back the world's manualCycle.

### rate an appraisal

Starts from the world `a manual cycle draft`.

- **and completes H1 2027.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisalCycle the world's manualCycle, and gets back the world's manualCycle.

### run an appraisal cycle

Starts from the world `a three-person cycle`.

- **Ada can't complete it before it starts.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisalCycle the world's appraisalCycle, and is refused with AppraisalCycleNotNotStarted, CY-900, carrying state `notStarted`.

- **Bo can't complete it.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends appraisalCycle the world's appraisalCycle, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **nor can Olga.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends appraisalCycle the world's appraisalCycle, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **it still can't complete while Cy's is a draft.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisalCycle the world's appraisalCycle, and is refused with AppraisalsNotSubmitted, CY-007, carrying drafts `1`.
- **Ada completes the cycle.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisalCycle the world's appraisalCycle, and gets back the world's appraisalCycle.
- **it can't complete twice.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisalCycle the world's appraisalCycle, and is refused with AppraisalCycleNotNotStarted, CY-900, carrying state `completed`.

### set and track goals

Starts from the world `a started manual cycle`.

- **and completes H2 2026.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisalCycle the world's appraisalCycle, and gets back the world's appraisalCycle.

```sh
capxul appraisal-cycle complete --appraisalCycle <appraisalCycle>
```

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| TemplateWithoutKras | 41 | TP-001 | declared in errors.ts |
| TemplateKraNotInCompany | 42 | TP-002 | declared in errors.ts |
| TemplateCriteriaNotInCompany | 43 | TP-003 | declared in errors.ts |
| TemplateLineRepeated | 44 | TP-004 | declared in errors.ts |
| TemplateWeightageOutOfRange | 45 | TP-005 | declared in errors.ts |
| KraWeightageNotHundred | 46 | TP-006 | declared in errors.ts |

| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### appraise a year

Starts from the world `a second feedback criteria`.

- **Ada makes the Platform template: Quality 60 and Development 40, rated on Problem Solving and Excellence, 50 each.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Platform team`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `60`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, weightage: { value: `40`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's criteria, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }], and gets back an answer matching `^apt_[0-9a-z]+$`.

### run an appraisal cycle

Starts from the world `a three-person cycle`.

- **Ada makes a template in Acme Logistics.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, title `Drivers`, kras [{ kra: the world's outsideKra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and gets back an answer matching `^apt_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Ada makes a template of one KRA, Quality at 100, and no criteria.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Quality only`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and gets back an answer matching `^apt_[0-9a-z]+$`.

### set up appraisal templates

Starts from the world `an outside criteria`.

- **Ada makes a template of two KRAs and two criteria.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Engineers`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `30`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, weightage: { value: `70`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's criteria, weightage: { value: `70`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, weightage: { value: `30`, scale: 0 } }], and gets back an answer matching `^apt_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Olga can't make a template.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Olga's`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Bo can't make one in Acme Trading.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Bo's`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **a template with no criteria and weightages in hundredths is allowed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Thirds`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `3333`, scale: 2 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, weightage: { value: `6667`, scale: 2 } }], criteria [], and gets back an answer matching `^apt_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **one KRA may carry the whole hundred, and criteria in tenths.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Quality only`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's criteria, weightage: { value: `101`, scale: 1 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, weightage: { value: `899`, scale: 1 } }], and gets back an answer matching `^apt_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **KRAs a hundredth short of 100 are refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Short`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `30`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, weightage: { value: `6999`, scale: 2 } }], criteria [], and is refused with KraWeightageNotHundred, TP-006.
- **and so are KRAs a hundredth over.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Over`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `3001`, scale: 2 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, weightage: { value: `70`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and is refused with KraWeightageNotHundred, TP-006.
- **and one KRA of 50 alone.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Half`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and is refused with KraWeightageNotHundred, TP-006.
- **criteria a hundredth short of 100 are refused, though the KRAs total 100.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Short criteria`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's criteria, weightage: { value: `70`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, weightage: { value: `2999`, scale: 2 } }], and is refused with CriteriaWeightageNotHundred, TP-007.
- **and criteria over 100.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Over criteria`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's criteria, weightage: { value: `70`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, weightage: { value: `40`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with CriteriaWeightageNotHundred, TP-007.
- **when both totals are off, the KRAs' is judged first.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Both off`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `30`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, weightage: { value: `60`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's criteria, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, weightage: { value: `40`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with KraWeightageNotHundred, TP-006.
- **a line over 100 is refused as out of range, judged before the KRAs' total.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Too heavy`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `150`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and is refused with TemplateWeightageOutOfRange, TP-005.
- **a line of weightage 0 is refused, though the total is 100.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Zero line`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `0`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and is refused with TemplateWeightageOutOfRange, TP-005.
- **and so are a line over 100 and a negative one that make 100 between them.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Lopsided`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `150`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's otherKra, weightage: { value: `-50`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and is refused with TemplateWeightageOutOfRange, TP-005.
- **and a criteria of weightage 0, before the criteria's total.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Zero criteria`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's criteria, weightage: { value: `0`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, weightage: { value: `90`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with TemplateWeightageOutOfRange, TP-005.
- **a template with no KRA is refused, even with criteria from another company.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Empty`, kras [], criteria [{ criteria: the world's outsideCriteria, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with TemplateWithoutKras, TP-001.
- **a KRA of Acme Logistics is refused, judged before a criteria of Acme Logistics.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Mixed`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's outsideKra, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's outsideCriteria, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with TemplateKraNotInCompany, TP-002.
- **a criteria of Acme Logistics is refused, judged before a repeated KRA.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Mixed criteria`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's criteria, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's outsideCriteria, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with TemplateCriteriaNotInCompany, TP-003.
- **a KRA listed twice is refused, judged before a line of weightage 0.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Twice`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }, { kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `0`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and is refused with TemplateLineRepeated, TP-004.
- **and so is a criteria listed twice.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Twice criteria`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's criteria, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's criteria, weightage: { value: `50`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with TemplateLineRepeated, TP-004.
- **a title taken in Acme Trading is refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Engineers`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and is refused with TemplateTitleTaken, TP-008, carrying title `Engineers`.
- **a taken title is judged after the weightages.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, title `Engineers`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `99`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and is refused with KraWeightageNotHundred, TP-006.
- **Acme Logistics may use the title for its own KRA and criteria.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, title `Engineers`, kras [{ kra: the world's outsideKra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [{ criteria: the world's outsideCriteria, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], and gets back an answer matching `^apt_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **but not with Acme Trading's KRA.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, title `Borrowed`, kras [{ kra: the world's kra, weightage: { value: `100`, scale: 0 } }], criteria [], and is refused with TemplateKraNotInCompany, TP-002.

## How to call

```sh
capxul appraisal-template create --company <company> --title <title> --kras <kras> --criteria <criteria>
```

HTTP: `POST /appraisal-template/create` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.appraisal-template.create(payload)`.

# appraisal.submit

Submit an appraisal.

**Who may call:** the owner of its appraisal.company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 150ms.

## Payload

| field | value |

## Answer

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| appraisal | appraisal.id |  |
| finalScore | appraisal.finalScore | The average of the three scores above (HRMS's `final_score`). |
| appraisalCycle | appraisal.appraisalCycle |  |

## Move

`submit`: from draft to submitted, emitting AppraisalSubmitted.

## Steps

- `appraisal.submit.load` (database)
- `appraisal.submit.update` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |

| AppraisalNotDraft | 40 | AP-900 | the appraisal is in a state submit can't start from; carries `state` |

## Worked examples

### approve an attendance request

Starts from the world `an attendance request`.

- **Olga can't approve her own request.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends attendanceRequest the world's attendanceRequest, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **nor can Bo.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends attendanceRequest the world's attendanceRequest, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Ada approves it: two days are new, the absent Tuesday and the present Wednesday change, and Thursday is left as it was.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends attendanceRequest the world's attendanceRequest, and gets back [the world's attendanceRequest, `2`, `2`].
- **it can't be approved twice.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends attendanceRequest the world's attendanceRequest, and is refused with AttendanceRequestNotDraft, AQ-900, carrying state `approved`.
- **approved, the absent Monday and the half day change to present, and the present Tuesday is left: none is new.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends attendanceRequest the last call's attendanceRequest, and gets back [`0`, `2`].
- **approved, it marks the Friday and Sunday and changes the half-day Saturday.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends attendanceRequest the last call's attendanceRequest, and gets back [`2`, `1`].
- **approved, it marks that one day.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends attendanceRequest the last call's attendanceRequest, and gets back [`1`, `0`].
- **approved, it marks both, across the year's end.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends attendanceRequest the last call's attendanceRequest, and gets back [`2`, `0`].
- **approved, it marks three days, with no 29 February.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends attendanceRequest the last call's attendanceRequest, and gets back [`3`, `0`].
- **approved, it marks 28 February and 1 March and changes 29 February to present.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends attendanceRequest the last call's attendanceRequest, and gets back [`2`, `1`].
- **approved, it marks all forty.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends attendanceRequest the last call's attendanceRequest, and gets back [`40`, `0`].
- **approved, it marks all three, the weekend too.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends attendanceRequest the last call's attendanceRequest, and gets back [`3`, `0`].

### attendance requests and leave

Starts from the world `a leave application`.

- **Ada approves it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends attendanceRequest the last call's attendanceRequest, and is answered.
- **Ada approves the request: it marks the four days around the leave and leaves the leave's days On Leave.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends attendanceRequest the last call's attendanceRequest, and gets back [`4`, `0`].
- **Ada approves it: the open leave doesn't stop it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends attendanceRequest the last call's attendanceRequest, and gets back [`1`, `0`].
- **Ada approves it: Olga's leave doesn't stop his days, two new and his present Tuesday changed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends attendanceRequest the last call's attendanceRequest, and gets back [`2`, `1`].
- **Ada approves it: the cancelled leave's On Leave day changes to working from home.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends attendanceRequest the last call's attendanceRequest, and gets back [`0`, `1`].

### attendance stays in its company

Starts from the world `an attendance request`.

- **the request she made before leaving is still approved, marking its days.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends attendanceRequest the world's attendanceRequest, and gets back [the world's attendanceRequest, `4`, `1`].

# bank-account

A bank account a company holds through Bridge, which takes deposits in one currency.

Lives in the database.

## Fields

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| id | id |  |
| company | company.id |  |
| business | bridge-business.id | The company's approved KYB the account is opened on. |
| accountName | Name | What the company calls the account (ERPNext's `account_name`). |
| currency | AccountCurrency | The currency it takes deposits in. |
| bankName | DepositDetail | The bank that holds it, as Bridge names it. |
| accountNumber | DepositDetail | Its account number, or IBAN, as Bridge gives it. |
| routingNumber | DepositDetail | Its routing number, or BIC, as Bridge gives it. |

## Machine

States: open, closed. A move from the wrong state is refused BankAccountNotOpen (exit 40).

| move | from | to | emits |
|---|---|---|---|
| open | (creates) | open | BankAccountOpened |
| close | open | closed | BankAccountClosed |

## Invariants

- `bank-account.oneAccountPerNumber`: another bank account holds this account number. Unique on accountNumber, in every state; refuses nothing, a break is a defect.
- `bank-account.oneNamePerCompany`: another open bank account holds this company and account name. Unique on company, accountName, while open; refused BankAccountNameTaken.

## Events

- `BankAccountClosed`: carries account (bank-account.id); emitted by the move close
- `BankAccountOpened`: carries account (bank-account.id), company (bank-account.company), business (bank-account.business: The company's approved KYB the account is opened on.), currency (bank-account.currency: The currency it takes deposits in.); emitted by the move open

## Operations

- [bank-account.close](close.md): Close a company's bank account; it takes no more deposits.
- [bank-account.get](get.md): Read one bank-account by its id: company, business, accountName, currency, bankName, accountNumber, routingNumber, state.
- [bank-account.open](open.md): Open a bank account for a company whose KYB Bridge approved: answers where to send deposits.

|---|---|---|---|
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its company; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### bridge: a bank account, end to end

Starts from an empty world.

- **Ada reads the deposit back.** `ada` (signed in) calls and sends id the last call's transaction, and gets back [`2026-11-30`, `500000000`, `0`, `USD`, `dep_first01`, `First Customer`, `settled`].
- **Ada reads the transfer back paid.** `ada` (signed in) calls and sends id the last call's transaction, and gets back [`2026-12-01`, `0`, `120750000`, `USD`, `ea_supplier`, `settled`].

### bridge: a deposit lands

Starts from the world `two bank accounts`.

- **Bo can't read it.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends id the last call's transaction, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Ada reads it back: a deposit on Operating, in its currency, and nothing withdrawn.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the last call's transaction, and gets back [the world's company, the world's account, `2026-11-30`, `1250500000`, `0`, `USD`, `dep_8f2c41a7`, `Jane Payer`, `settled`].
- **it reads back as the smallest deposit, not the one before it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the last call's transaction, and gets back [`dep_micro01`, `1`, `Bridge test`].
- **it reads back on Payroll, in euros at the bank.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the last call's transaction, and gets back [the world's company, the world's payroll, `2026-12-01`, `1234567891`, `0`, `EUR`, `dep_eur0001`, `Rhein GmbH`, `settled`].

### bridge: a transfer is paid or returned

Starts from the world `a transfer sent`.

- **Ada reads it back pending, with the reference she was given.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the world's transfer, and gets back [the world's company, the world's account, `2026-12-01`, `0`, `300250000`, `USD`, the world's transferReference, `ea_landlord`, `pending`].
- **it reads back failed, nothing else changed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the last call's transaction, and gets back [the world's company, the world's account, `2026-12-01`, `0`, `950000000`, `USD`, `ea_old_tenant`, `failed`].
- **it is dated that day in UTC, not the next.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the last call's transaction, and gets back [`2026-12-01`, `ea_late`].
- **it is dated the new day, not the one before.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the last call's transaction, and gets back [`2026-12-02`, `ea_early`].
- **it reads back paid, still dated the day it was sent, nothing else changed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the world's transfer, and gets back [the world's company, the world's account, `2026-12-01`, `0`, `300250000`, `USD`, the world's transferReference, `ea_landlord`, `settled`].

### bridge: each company's money is its own

Starts from the world `two companies' accounts`.

- **Bo can't read it.** `bo` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the last call's transaction, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Ada reads it back as Acme Trading's.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the last call's transaction, and gets back [the world's company, the world's account, `40000000`, `dep_acme01`].
- **Bo can't read Ada's transfer.** `bo` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the last call's transaction, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Ada reads it back as Acme Trading's.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the last call's transaction, and gets back [the world's company, the world's account, `15000000`, `ea_acme_supplier`].
- **Ada can't read Bo's deposit.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the last call's transaction, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Bo reads it back on his account.** `bo` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the last call's transaction, and gets back [the world's boAccount, `7000000`, `dep_bo01`].

### bridge: send money out

Starts from the world `a reopened account`.

- **Bo can't read it.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends id the last call's transaction, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **it reads back pending on Payroll, in euros at the bank.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the last call's transaction, and gets back [the world's company, the world's payroll, `0`, `1000001`, `EUR`, `ea_rhein_supplier`, `pending`].

# bank-transaction

One movement of money on a company's bank account: a deposit Bridge landed, or a transfer out.

Lives in the database.

## Fields

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| id | id |  |
| company | company.id |  |
| account | bank-account.id | The company's bank account the money moved on. |
| date | Day | The day the money moved, as Bridge dates it. |
| deposit | Amount | What came in, in USDC base units; 0 for a transfer out. |
| withdrawal | Amount | What went out, in USDC base units; 0 for a deposit. |
| currency | AccountCurrency | The bank account's currency, which the money moved in at the bank. |
| reference | BridgeRef | Bridge's id for the movement: the deposit's, or the transfer's. |
| party | Party | Who sent the deposit, or the external account the transfer pays. |

## Machine

States: pending, settled, failed. A move from the wrong state is refused BankTransactionNotPending (exit 40).

| move | from | to | emits |
|---|---|---|---|
| land | (creates) | settled | DepositLanded |
| send | (creates) | pending | TransferSent |
| settle | pending | settled | TransferSettled |
| fail | pending | failed | TransferFailed |

## Invariants

- `bank-transaction.oneTransactionPerMovement`: another bank transaction holds this reference. Unique on reference, in every state; refused AlreadyRecorded.

## Events

- `DepositLanded`: carries transaction (bank-transaction.id), account (bank-transaction.account: The company's bank account the money moved on.), deposit (bank-transaction.deposit: What came in, in USDC base units; 0 for a transfer out.), reference (bank-transaction.reference: Bridge's id for the movement: the deposit's, or the transfer's.); emitted by the move land
- `TransferFailed`: carries transaction (bank-transaction.id), state (TransferFailure); emitted by the move fail
- `TransferSent`: carries transaction (bank-transaction.id), account (bank-transaction.account: The company's bank account the money moved on.), withdrawal (bank-transaction.withdrawal: What went out, in USDC base units; 0 for a deposit.); emitted by the move send
- `TransferSettled`: carries transaction (bank-transaction.id); emitted by the move settle

## Operations

- [bank-transaction.fail](fail.md): Record that Bridge couldn't pay a transfer out, and how it ended.
- [bank-transaction.get](get.md): Read one bank-transaction by its id: company, account, date, deposit, withdrawal, currency, reference, party, state.
- [bank-transaction.land](land.md): Record a deposit Bridge landed on a company's bank account.
- [bank-transaction.list](list.md): List bank-transactions, oldest first, 50 to a page, filtered by account.
- [bank-transaction.send](send.md): Send money out of a company's bank account to a payee, through Bridge.
- [bank-transaction.settle](settle.md): Record that Bridge paid a transfer out.

# bank-transaction.land

Record a deposit Bridge landed on a company's bank account.

**Who may call:** the system.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 150ms.

## Payload

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| account | bank-transaction.account | The company's bank account the money moved on. |
| reference | bank-transaction.reference | Bridge's id for the movement: the deposit's, or the transfer's. |
| amount | Dollars | What landed, as Bridge writes it: dollars, at most six places. |
| party | bank-transaction.party | Who sent the deposit, or the external account the transfer pays. |
| date | bank-transaction.date | The day the money moved, as Bridge dates it. |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| transaction | bank-transaction.id |

## Move

`land`: from nothing (it creates) to settled, emitting DepositLanded.

## Steps

- `bank-transaction.land.load` (database)
- `bank-transaction.land.insert` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| AlreadyRecorded | 44 | BT-004 | another bank transaction holds this reference; by the rule bank-transaction.oneTransactionPerMovement, carrying reference |
| BankAccountNotFound | 4 | BA-901 | nothing has the id in account; the handler never runs; carries `id` |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the system; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### bridge: a bank account, end to end

Starts from an empty world.

- **Bridge lands a deposit on it.** `bridge` (system) calls and sends account the last call's account, reference `dep_first01`, amount { value: `500`, scale: 0 }, party `First Customer`, date `2026-11-30`, and is answered.

### bridge: a deposit lands

Starts from the world `two bank accounts`.

- **Ada can't report a deposit herself: only Bridge does.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's account, reference `dep_ada01`, amount { value: `10`, scale: 0 }, party `Ada Lovelace`, date `2026-11-30`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Bridge lands a deposit of 1,250.50 dollars on Operating.** `bridge` (system) calls and sends account the world's account, reference `dep_8f2c41a7`, amount { value: `12505`, scale: 1 }, party `Jane Payer`, date `2026-11-30`, and gets back an answer matching `^btx_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Bridge reports the same deposit again, and it is recorded once.** `bridge` (system) calls and sends account the world's account, reference `dep_8f2c41a7`, amount { value: `12505`, scale: 1 }, party `Jane Payer`, date `2026-11-30`, and is refused with AlreadyRecorded, BT-004, carrying reference `dep_8f2c41a7`.
- **a later report of that deposit, a day on, is the same deposit.** `bridge` (system) calls and sends account the world's account, reference `dep_8f2c41a7`, amount { value: `125050`, scale: 2 }, party `Jane Payer`, date `2026-12-01`, and is refused with AlreadyRecorded, BT-004, carrying reference `dep_8f2c41a7`.
- **Bridge lands the smallest deposit there is, one millionth of a dollar.** `bridge` (system) calls and sends account the world's account, reference `dep_micro01`, amount { value: `1`, scale: 6 }, party `Bridge test`, date `2026-12-01`, and is answered.
- **1.005 dollars is exactly 1005000, not a float's 1004999.** `bridge` (system) calls and sends account the world's account, reference `dep_half_cent`, amount { value: `1005`, scale: 3 }, party `Jane Payer`, date `2026-12-01`, and is answered.
- **a deposit past a float's whole numbers is exact to the millionth.** `bridge` (system) calls and sends account the world's account, reference `dep_large01`, amount { value: `9007199254740993`, scale: 6 }, party `Big Payer`, date `2026-12-01`, and is answered.
- **Bridge lands a deposit on Payroll with all six places.** `bridge` (system) calls and sends account the world's payroll, reference `dep_eur0001`, amount { value: `1234567891`, scale: 6 }, party `Rhein GmbH`, date `2026-12-01`, and is answered.

### bridge: each company's money is its own

Starts from the world `two companies' accounts`.

- **Bridge lands a deposit on Acme Trading's account.** `bridge` (system) calls and sends account the world's account, reference `dep_acme01`, amount { value: `40`, scale: 0 }, party `Acme Customer`, date `2026-11-30`, and gets back an answer matching `^btx_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Bridge lands a deposit on Bo's account.** `bridge` (system) calls and sends account the world's boAccount, reference `dep_bo01`, amount { value: `7`, scale: 0 }, party `Bo Customer`, date `2026-11-30`, and gets back an answer matching `^btx_[0-9a-z]+$`.

## How to call

```sh
capxul bank-transaction land --account <account> --reference <reference> --amount <amount> --party <party> --date <date>
```

HTTP: `POST /bank-transaction/land` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.bank-transaction.land(payload)`.

`send`: from nothing (it creates) to pending, emitting TransferSent.

- `bank-transaction.send.insert` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| AccountClosed | 41 | BT-001 | declared in errors.ts, carrying account |
| CurrencyNotHeld | 42 | BT-002 | declared in errors.ts, carrying currency |
| NothingToSend | 43 | BT-003 | declared in errors.ts |
| AlreadyRecorded | 44 | BT-004 | another bank transaction holds this reference; by the rule bank-transaction.oneTransactionPerMovement, carrying reference |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its account.company; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### bridge: a bank account, end to end

Starts from an empty world.

- **Ada sends part of it out to a supplier.** `ada` (signed in) calls and sends account the last call's account, amount { value: `12075`, scale: 2 }, currency `USD`, party `ea_supplier`, with the request key `pay-supplier`, and gets back an answer matching `\S`.

### bridge: a transfer is paid or returned

Starts from the world `a transfer sent`.

- **the same request again is the same transfer, and sends nothing more.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's account, amount { value: `30025`, scale: 2 }, currency `USD`, party `ea_landlord`, with the request key `rent-december`, and gets back [the world's transfer, the world's transferReference].
- **Ada sends a deposit back to a tenant who moved out.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's account, amount { value: `950`, scale: 0 }, currency `USD`, party `ea_old_tenant`, with the request key `deposit-refund`, and gets back an answer matching `\S`.
- **Ada pays the cleaner too.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's account, amount { value: `80`, scale: 0 }, currency `USD`, party `ea_cleaner`, with the request key `cleaner`, and is answered.
- **Ada pays late in the day.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's account, amount { value: `5`, scale: 0 }, currency `USD`, party `ea_late`, with the request key `late`, and is answered.
- **Ada pays just after midnight.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's account, amount { value: `6`, scale: 0 }, currency `USD`, party `ea_early`, with the request key `early`, and is answered.

### bridge: each company's money is its own

Starts from the world `two companies' accounts`.

- **Ada pays a supplier from Acme Trading's account.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's account, amount { value: `15`, scale: 0 }, currency `USD`, party `ea_acme_supplier`, with the request key `acme-supplier`, and gets back an answer matching `^btx_[0-9a-z]+$`.

### bridge: send money out

Starts from the world `a reopened account`.

- **Bo can't send from Ada's account.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends account the world's account, amount { value: `10`, scale: 0 }, currency `USD`, party `ea_bo_payee`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **nothing is sent from the closed account.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's old, amount { value: `10`, scale: 0 }, currency `USD`, party `ea_landlord`, and is refused with AccountClosed, BT-001, carrying account the world's old.
- **a closed account is refused before its currency or the amount is judged.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's old, amount { value: `0`, scale: 0 }, currency `EUR`, party `ea_landlord`, and is refused with AccountClosed, BT-001, carrying account the world's old.
- **the dollar account doesn't pay in euros.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's account, amount { value: `10`, scale: 0 }, currency `EUR`, party `ea_landlord`, and is refused with CurrencyNotHeld, BT-002, carrying currency `EUR`.
- **nor the euro account in dollars, and the currency is judged before the amount.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's payroll, amount { value: `0`, scale: 0 }, currency `USD`, party `ea_landlord`, and is refused with CurrencyNotHeld, BT-002, carrying currency `USD`.
- **a transfer of nothing is refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's account, amount { value: `0`, scale: 0 }, currency `USD`, party `ea_landlord`, and is refused with NothingToSend, BT-003.
- **and so is one below nothing.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's account, amount { value: `-1`, scale: 6 }, currency `USD`, party `ea_landlord`, and is refused with NothingToSend, BT-003.
- **Ada pays her landlord the rent.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's account, amount { value: `30025`, scale: 2 }, currency `USD`, party `ea_landlord`, with the request key `rent-december`, and gets back an answer matching `^btx_[0-9a-z]+$` and gets back an answer matching `\S`.
- **a second transfer is its own.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's account, amount { value: `30025`, scale: 2 }, currency `USD`, party `ea_landlord`, with the request key `rent-december-again`, and is answered.

- **a transfer past a float's whole numbers is exact to the millionth.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's account, amount { value: `9007199254740993`, scale: 6 }, currency `USD`, party `ea_landlord`, and is answered.

Start your own KYC with Bridge: answers the form you fill in, and Bridge's terms.

**Who may call:** anyone signed in.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 800ms.

## Payload

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| fullName | bridge-individual.fullName | The person's name as their documents give it, which Bridge checks. |
| email | bridge-individual.email | Where Bridge writes to the person about their KYC. |

## Answer

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| individual | bridge-individual.id |  |
| kycLink | bridge-individual.kycLink | Bridge's hosted KYC form for this person. |
| tosLink | bridge-individual.tosLink | Bridge's terms of service, which the person accepts before they are approved. |

## Move

`start`: from nothing (it creates) to started, emitting KycStarted.

## Steps

- `bridge-individual.start.insert` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| KycAlreadyStarted | 41 | KC-001 | another bridge individual holds this person; by the rule bridge-individual.oneKycPerPerson, carrying person |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't anyone signed in; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### bridge: a bank account, end to end

Starts from an empty world.

- **Ada starts her own KYC and gets Bridge's form and terms.** `ada` (signed in) calls and sends fullName `Ada Wanjiru Kamau`, email `ada@acme-trading.test`, with the request key `ada-kyc`, and gets back true.

### bridge: a person is checked

Starts from an empty world.

- **the system can't start a KYC: it is nobody.** `bridge` (system) calls and sends fullName `Nobody At All`, email `nobody@capxul.test`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Ada starts her own KYC and gets Bridge's form and terms.** `ada` (signed in) calls and sends fullName `Ada Wanjiru Kamau`, email `ada@acme-trading.test`, with the request key `ada-kyc`, and gets back an answer matching `^kyc_[0-9a-z]+$` and gets back an answer matching `^https:\/\/\S+$` and gets back an answer matching `^https:\/\/\S+$`.
- **a person has one KYC, so a second start is refused.** `ada` (signed in) calls and sends fullName `Ada W. Kamau`, email `ada.k@acme-trading.test`, and is refused with KycAlreadyStarted, KC-001, carrying person the cast's ada person.
- **Bo starts his own, which Ada's doesn't block.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends fullName `Bo Otieno`, email `bo@bo-ltd.test`, and gets back an answer matching `^kyc_[0-9a-z]+$`.

## How to call

```sh
capxul bridge-individual start --fullName <fullName> --email <email>
```

HTTP: `POST /bridge-individual/start` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.bridge-individual.start(payload)`.

| field | value |
|---|---|

## Move

`create`: from nothing (it creates) to active, emitting CompanyCreated.

## Steps

- `company.create.insert` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| CompanyAbbrTaken | 42 | CO-002 | another company holds this owner and abbr; by the rule company.oneAbbrPerOwner, carrying abbr |
| CompanyNameTaken | 41 | CO-001 | another company holds this owner and company name; by the rule company.oneNamePerOwner, carrying companyName |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't anyone signed in; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

Starts from the world `a team`.

# company.get

Read one company by its id: companyName, abbr, country, defaultCurrency, owner, state.

**Who may call:** the owner of the company.

**A read:** answered from the records, with no handler.

**Budget:** p95 50ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| id | company.id |

## Answer

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| companyName | company.companyName |  |
| abbr | company.abbr |  |
| country | company.country |  |
| defaultCurrency | company.defaultCurrency |  |
| owner | company.owner | The person who set the company up, and runs it. |
| state | text |  |

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of the company; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### branch names are the company's

Starts from the world `four branches`.

- **her first company is unchanged by its branches.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the world's company, and gets back [`Acme Trading`, `AT`, `Kenya`, `USD`, the cast's ada person, `active`].
- **and so is her second.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the world's otherCompany, and gets back [`Acme Logistics`, `AL`, `Uganda`, `UGX`, the cast's ada person, `active`].
- **and Bo's.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends id the world's boCompany, and gets back [`Bo Ltd`, `BL`, `Tanzania`, `TZS`, the cast's bo person, `active`].

### companies are kept apart

Starts from the world `a company`.

- **her second company reads back as she typed it, not as her first.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the last call's company, and gets back [`Acme Holdings`, `AH`, `Uganda`, `UGX`, the cast's ada person, `active`].
- **Bo still can't read Ada's.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends id the world's company, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Ada's company is untouched and still hers.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the world's company, and gets back [`Acme Trading`, `AT`, `Kenya`, `USD`, the cast's ada person, `active`].

### grade names are the company's

Starts from the world `four grades`.

- **her first company is unchanged by its grades.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the world's company, and gets back [`Acme Trading`, `AT`, `Kenya`, `USD`, the cast's ada person, `active`].
- **and so is her second.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends id the world's otherCompany, and gets back [`Acme Logistics`, `AL`, `Uganda`, `UGX`, the cast's ada person, `active`].
- **and Bo's.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends id the world's boCompany, and gets back [`Bo Ltd`, `BL`, `Tanzania`, `TZS`, the cast's bo person, `active`].

### set up a company

Starts from an empty world.

- **Bo can't read a company he doesn't run.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends id the last call's company, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **reading it back shows what she typed, with her as its owner.** `ada` (signed in) calls and sends id the last call's company, and gets back [`Acme Trading`, `AT`, `Kenya`, `USD`, the cast's ada person, `active`].
- **Ada can't read Bo's company.** `ada` (signed in) calls and sends id the last call's company, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Bo reads his back, exactly as he typed it.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends id the last call's company, and gets back [`Kilimanjaro Coffee Exporters`, `KCE`, `Tanzania`, `TZS`, the cast's bo person, `active`].

## How to call

```sh
capxul company get --id <id>
```

HTTP: `POST /company/get` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.company.get(payload)`.

# cost-center.create

Add a cost center to a company, under a group or as a root.

**Who may call:** the owner of its company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 150ms.

## Payload

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| company | cost-center.company |  |
| costCenterName | cost-center.costCenterName |  |
| parentCostCenter (optional) | cost-center.parentCostCenter |  |
| isGroup | YesNo | Make it a group, which other cost centers sit under, rather than a ledger, which takes entries. |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| costCenter | cost-center.id |

## Move

`create`: from nothing (it creates) to group or ledger, emitting CostCenterCreated.

## Steps

- `cost-center.create.load` (database)
- `cost-center.create.insert` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| ParentCostCenterNotInCompany | 41 | CC-001 | declared in errors.ts |
| ParentCostCenterIsLedger | 42 | CC-002 | declared in errors.ts |
| RootCostCenterIsLedger | 43 | CC-003 | declared in errors.ts |
| CostCenterNameTaken | 44 | CC-004 | another cost center holds this company and cost center name; by the rule cost-center.oneNamePerCompany |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its company; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### draft a journal entry

Starts from the world `a fiscal year`.

- **Ada adds a root cost center to her other company.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, costCenterName `Acme Logistics`, isGroup true, and gets back an answer matching `^cct_`.
- **and a ledger cost center under it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, costCenterName `Operations`, parentCostCenter the last call's costCenter, isGroup false, and gets back an answer matching `^cct_`.

### draft a payment entry

Starts from the world `an outside supplier`.

- **Ada adds a group cost center under the root.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, costCenterName `Sales`, parentCostCenter the world's mainCostCenter, isGroup true, and gets back an answer matching `^cct_`.

### post a journal entry

Starts from the world `a capital entry`.

- **Ada adds a second ledger cost center under the root.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, costCenterName `Sales`, parentCostCenter the world's mainCostCenter, isGroup false, and gets back an answer matching `^cct_[0-9a-z]+$`.

### set up cost centers

Starts from the world `a chart`.

- **nor add a cost center to Acme Trading.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends company the world's company, costCenterName `Sales`, parentCostCenter the world's mainCostCenter, isGroup false, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Ada adds Regions, a group under the root.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, costCenterName `Regions`, parentCostCenter the world's mainCostCenter, isGroup true, and gets back an answer matching `^cct_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **and Nairobi, a ledger under Regions.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, costCenterName `Nairobi`, parentCostCenter the last call's costCenter, isGroup false, and is answered.
- **a cost center under a ledger is refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, costCenterName `Sales`, parentCostCenter the world's costCenter, isGroup false, and is refused with ParentCostCenterIsLedger, CC-002.
- **a group under one too.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, costCenterName `Sales`, parentCostCenter the world's costCenter, isGroup true, and is refused with ParentCostCenterIsLedger, CC-002.
- **a root that isn't a group is refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, costCenterName `Head Office`, isGroup false, and is refused with RootCostCenterIsLedger, CC-003.
- **a second cost center under a taken name is refused, under any parent.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, costCenterName `Operations`, parentCostCenter the world's mainCostCenter, isGroup true, and is refused with CostCenterNameTaken, CC-004.
- **a taken name under a ledger is refused for the ledger first.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, costCenterName `Operations`, parentCostCenter the world's costCenter, isGroup false, and is refused with ParentCostCenterIsLedger, CC-002.
- **Ada's other company starts its own cost centers, under its own name.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, costCenterName `Acme Logistics`, isGroup true, and is answered.
- **an Acme Trading cost center under it is refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, costCenterName `Kampala`, parentCostCenter the last call's costCenter, isGroup false, and is refused with ParentCostCenterNotInCompany, CC-001.
- **the other company may reuse Acme Trading's ledger's name for a ledger of its own.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, costCenterName `Operations`, parentCostCenter the last call's costCenter, isGroup false, and is answered.
- **an Acme Trading cost center under that ledger is refused for the company first.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, costCenterName `Kampala`, parentCostCenter the last call's costCenter, isGroup true, and is refused with ParentCostCenterNotInCompany, CC-001.

## How to call

```sh
capxul cost-center create --company <company> --costCenterName <costCenterName> [--parentCostCenter <parentCostCenter>] --isGroup <isGroup>
```

HTTP: `POST /cost-center/create` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.cost-center.create(payload)`.

A customer's balance on a day, from the ledger lines posted with it as their party.

**Who may call:** the owner of its customer.company.

## Steps

- `customer.balance.sum` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its customer.company; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### add customers and suppliers

Starts from the world `an outside supplier`.

- **a new customer's balance is nothing.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends customer the world's customer, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `0`, `0`] and gets back the world's customer.
- **Bo can't read it.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends customer the world's customer, onDay `2026-12-31`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.

### draft a payment entry

Starts from the world `an outside supplier`.

- **and Kibo Stores' balance is nothing.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends customer the world's customer, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `0`, `0`].

### post a payment entry

Starts from the world `a received advance`.

- **Kibo Stores' balance is the advance received, negative.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends customer the world's customer, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `500000000`, `-500000000`] and gets back the world's customer.
- **on the payment's own day too.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends customer the world's customer, onDay `2026-02-10`, and gets back [`0`, `500000000`, `-500000000`].
- **but not the day before.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends customer the world's customer, onDay `2026-02-09`, and gets back [`0`, `0`, `0`].
- **Bo can't read Kibo Stores' balance.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends customer the world's customer, onDay `2026-12-31`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Kibo Stores' balance is nothing again.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends customer the world's customer, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `0`, `0`].
- **Kibo Stores' balance doesn't move.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends customer the world's customer, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`0`, `0`, `0`].
- **Kibo Stores' balance is 100 USDC owed, positive.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends customer the world's customer, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`100000000`, `0`, `100000000`].
- **and nothing on 31 March.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends customer the world's customer, onDay `2026-03-31`, and gets back [`0`, `0`, `0`].
- **the first Kibo Stores' balance doesn't move.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends customer the world's customer, onDay `2026-12-31`, and gets back [`100000000`, `0`, `100000000`].
- **Kibo Stores' balance counts both base units, and none of the refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends customer the world's customer, onDay `2027-12-31`, and gets back [`100000000`, `2`, `99999998`].
- **Kibo Stores' balance in 2029 counts the one that posted.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends customer the world's customer, onDay `2029-12-31`, and gets back [`100000000`, `5`, `99999995`].
- **a disabled customer's balance still reads from the ledger.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends customer the world's customer, onDay `2027-12-31`, and gets back [`100000000`, `2`, `99999998`].

## How to call

```sh
capxul customer balance --customer <customer> --onDay <onDay>
```

HTTP: `POST /customer/balance` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.customer.balance(payload)`.

| field | value | description |

| field | value | description |

## Steps

- `employee-performance-feedback.create.load` (database)
