## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| FeedbackCycleCompleted | 41 | PF-007 | declared in errors.ts |
| FeedbackForOneself | 42 | PF-002 | declared in errors.ts |
| ReviewerNotInCompany | 43 | PF-003 | declared in errors.ts |
| ReviewerHasLeft | 44 | PF-004 | declared in errors.ts |
| FeedbackRatingsDontMatchCriteria | 45 | PF-005 | declared in errors.ts |
| FeedbackRatingOutOfRange | 46 | PF-006 | declared in errors.ts |
| AppraisalNotFound | 4 | AP-901 | nothing has the id in appraisal; the handler never runs; carries `id` |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the self of its reviewer; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### appraise a year

Starts from the world `a second feedback criteria`.

- **Cy gives feedback on Olga's appraisal, 0.9 and 0.6: a total of 3.75.** `cy` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the last call's appraisal, reviewer the world's secondEmployee, feedback `Ship v2 landed well.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `9`, scale: 1 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, rating: { value: `6`, scale: 1 } }], and gets back `3.75`.

### give performance feedback

Starts from the world `a manual cycle draft`.

- **Ada can't give feedback in Cy's name.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's secondEmployee, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `1`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, rating: { value: `1`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **nor can Dee.** `dee` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's secondEmployee, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `1`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, rating: { value: `1`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Olga can't give feedback on her own appraisal, judged before ratings that don't match.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's employee, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `2`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with FeedbackForOneself, PF-002.
- **Bo of Acme Logistics can't give feedback on Acme Trading's appraisal, judged before ratings that don't match.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's outsider, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `2`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with ReviewerNotInCompany, PF-003.
- **ratings missing a criteria are refused, even out of range.** `dee` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's newHire, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `2`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with FeedbackRatingsDontMatchCriteria, PF-005.
- **and so are ratings naming a criteria twice.** `dee` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's newHire, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `5`, scale: 1 } }, { criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `5`, scale: 1 } }], and is refused with FeedbackRatingsDontMatchCriteria, PF-005.
- **and a criteria of Acme Logistics.** `dee` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's newHire, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `5`, scale: 1 } }, { criteria: the world's outsideCriteria, rating: { value: `5`, scale: 1 } }], and is refused with FeedbackRatingsDontMatchCriteria, PF-005.
- **and every criteria with one more.** `dee` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's newHire, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `5`, scale: 1 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, rating: { value: `5`, scale: 1 } }, { criteria: the world's outsideCriteria, rating: { value: `5`, scale: 1 } }], and is refused with FeedbackRatingsDontMatchCriteria, PF-005.
- **a rating over 1 is refused.** `dee` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's newHire, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `101`, scale: 2 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, rating: { value: `5`, scale: 1 } }], and is refused with FeedbackRatingOutOfRange, PF-006.
- **and one below 0.** `dee` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's newHire, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `5`, scale: 1 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, rating: { value: `-1`, scale: 2 } }], and is refused with FeedbackRatingOutOfRange, PF-006.
- **Dee rates Olga 0.2 and 1, in the other order: 0.7 and 1.5, a total of 2.2.** `dee` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's newHire, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's otherCriteria, rating: { value: `1`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `2`, scale: 1 } }], and gets back [the last call's employeePerformanceFeedback, `2.2`] and gets back an answer matching `^epf_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Cy may give Olga a second feedback, 1 and 0.5: a total of 4.25.** `cy` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's secondEmployee, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `1`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, rating: { value: `5`, scale: 1 } }], and gets back `4.25`.
- **and Cy gives feedback on it.** `cy` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the last call's appraisal, reviewer the world's secondEmployee, feedback `Early thoughts.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `6`, scale: 1 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, rating: { value: `6`, scale: 1 } }], and gets back `3`.
- **but she starts no new feedback, judged before ratings that don't match.** `dee` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's newHire, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `2`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with ReviewerHasLeft, PF-004.
- **Bo is judged as outside Acme Trading before as a leaver.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's appraisal, reviewer the world's outsider, feedback `Steady work.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `1`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, rating: { value: `1`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with ReviewerNotInCompany, PF-003.
- **nor any new feedback given there, judged before ratings that don't match.** `cy` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's manualAppraisal, reviewer the world's secondEmployee, feedback `Late.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `2`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with FeedbackCycleCompleted, PF-007.

- **and before a reviewer who has left.** `dee` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's manualAppraisal, reviewer the world's newHire, feedback `Late.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `1`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, rating: { value: `1`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with FeedbackCycleCompleted, PF-007.
- **and a reviewer of Acme Logistics.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends appraisal the world's manualAppraisal, reviewer the world's outsider, feedback `Late.`, ratings [{ criteria: the world's criteria, rating: { value: `1`, scale: 0 } }, { criteria: the world's otherCriteria, rating: { value: `1`, scale: 0 } }], and is refused with FeedbackCycleCompleted, PF-007.

# fiscal-year.create

Set up a company's fiscal year.

**Who may call:** the owner of its company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 150ms.

## Payload

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| company | fiscal-year.company |  |
| year | fiscal-year.year |  |
| yearStartDate | fiscal-year.yearStartDate |  |
| yearEndDate | fiscal-year.yearEndDate |  |
| isShortYear | fiscal-year.isShortYear | A year shorter than twelve months, as some countries allow (ERPNext's `is_short_year`). |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| fiscalYear | fiscal-year.id |

## Move

`create`: from nothing (it creates) to active, emitting FiscalYearCreated.

## Steps

- `fiscal-year.create.load` (database)
- `fiscal-year.create.insert` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| FiscalYearEndsBeforeStart | 41 | FY-001 | declared in errors.ts, carrying yearStartDate |
| FiscalYearWrongLength | 42 | FY-002 | declared in errors.ts, carrying yearEndDate |
| FiscalYearOverlaps | 43 | FY-003 | declared in errors.ts, carrying fiscalYear |
| FiscalYearNameTaken | 44 | FY-004 | another fiscal year holds this company and year; by the rule fiscal-year.oneNamePerCompany |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its company; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### keep the books

Starts from the world `a chart`.

- **Ada sets up the fiscal year 2026.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2026`, yearStartDate `2026-01-01`, yearEndDate `2026-12-31`, isShortYear false, and gets back an answer matching `^fyr_[0-9a-z]+$`.

### post a journal entry

Starts from the world `a capital entry`.

- **Acme Logistics sets up its own 2027.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, year `2027`, yearStartDate `2027-01-01`, yearEndDate `2027-12-31`, isShortYear false, and gets back an answer matching `^fyr_`.
- **Acme Trading sets up 2027 too.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2027`, yearStartDate `2027-01-01`, yearEndDate `2027-12-31`, isShortYear false, and gets back an answer matching `^fyr_`.
- **Acme Trading sets up a short year from April 2028 to February 2029, named for neither calendar year.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `FY28`, yearStartDate `2028-04-01`, yearEndDate `2029-02-28`, isShortYear true, and gets back an answer matching `^fyr_`.

### post a payment entry

Starts from the world `a received advance`.

- **Acme Logistics sets up 2027.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, year `2027`, yearStartDate `2027-01-01`, yearEndDate `2027-12-31`, isShortYear false, and gets back an answer matching `^fyr_`.
- **Acme Trading sets up FY28, from 1 April 2028 to 28 February 2029.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `FY28`, yearStartDate `2028-04-01`, yearEndDate `2029-02-28`, isShortYear true, and gets back an answer matching `^fyr_`.

### run a payroll

Starts from the world `an outside cost center`.

- **Acme Logistics sets up its next fiscal year, which holds that day.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, year `FY27`, yearStartDate `2027-01-01`, yearEndDate `2027-12-31`, isShortYear false, and is answered.

### set up fiscal years

Starts from the world `a fiscal year`.

- **nor set up a year for Acme Trading.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2027`, yearStartDate `2027-01-01`, yearEndDate `2027-12-31`, isShortYear false, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **a year that ends the day before it starts is refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2027`, yearStartDate `2027-01-01`, yearEndDate `2026-12-31`, isShortYear false, and is refused with FiscalYearEndsBeforeStart, FY-001, carrying yearStartDate `2027-01-01`.
- **a short one too, a month back, which is judged before its length.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2027`, yearStartDate `2027-03-01`, yearEndDate `2027-02-01`, isShortYear true, and is refused with FiscalYearEndsBeforeStart, FY-001, carrying yearStartDate `2027-03-01`.
- **and one that ends before it starts and overlaps 2026 is refused for its ends first.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2027`, yearStartDate `2026-06-01`, yearEndDate `2026-05-31`, isShortYear false, and is refused with FiscalYearEndsBeforeStart, FY-001, carrying yearStartDate `2026-06-01`.
- **a year a day short is refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2027`, yearStartDate `2027-01-01`, yearEndDate `2027-12-30`, isShortYear false, and is refused with FiscalYearWrongLength, FY-002, carrying yearEndDate `2027-12-31`.
- **so is a year a day long.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2027`, yearStartDate `2027-01-01`, yearEndDate `2028-01-01`, isShortYear false, and is refused with FiscalYearWrongLength, FY-002, carrying yearEndDate `2027-12-31`.
- **and a year a month short that isn't marked short.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2027`, yearStartDate `2027-04-01`, yearEndDate `2028-02-29`, isShortYear false, and is refused with FiscalYearWrongLength, FY-002, carrying yearEndDate `2028-03-31`.
- **a short year may not run longer than a year.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2027`, yearStartDate `2027-01-01`, yearEndDate `2028-01-01`, isShortYear true, and is refused with FiscalYearWrongLength, FY-002, carrying yearEndDate `2027-12-31`.
- **a year from mid 2025 to mid 2026 is the right length, but shares half of 2026, and names it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2025-2026`, yearStartDate `2025-07-01`, yearEndDate `2026-06-30`, isShortYear false, and is refused with FiscalYearOverlaps, FY-003, carrying fiscalYear the world's fiscalYear.
- **a year that shares only 2026's last day overlaps it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2026-2027`, yearStartDate `2026-12-31`, yearEndDate `2027-12-30`, isShortYear false, and is refused with FiscalYearOverlaps, FY-003, carrying fiscalYear the world's fiscalYear.
- **and one that shares only its first day.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2025-2026`, yearStartDate `2025-01-02`, yearEndDate `2026-01-01`, isShortYear false, and is refused with FiscalYearOverlaps, FY-003, carrying fiscalYear the world's fiscalYear.
- **a year of the wrong length that overlaps is refused for its length first.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2026b`, yearStartDate `2026-03-01`, yearEndDate `2027-03-01`, isShortYear false, and is refused with FiscalYearWrongLength, FY-002, carrying yearEndDate `2027-02-28`.
- **Ada sets up 2025, the year before, which touches 2026 without sharing a day.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2025`, yearStartDate `2025-01-01`, yearEndDate `2025-12-31`, isShortYear false, and gets back an answer matching `^fyr_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **a year from mid 2025 to mid 2026 now shares days with both, and names 2025, which starts first.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2025-2026`, yearStartDate `2025-07-01`, yearEndDate `2026-06-30`, isShortYear false, and is refused with FiscalYearOverlaps, FY-003, carrying fiscalYear the last call's fiscalYear.
- **a new year may not take 2026's name.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2026`, yearStartDate `2027-01-01`, yearEndDate `2027-12-31`, isShortYear false, and is refused with FiscalYearNameTaken, FY-004.
- **and an overlapping one under 2026's name is refused for the overlap first.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2026`, yearStartDate `2026-02-01`, yearEndDate `2027-01-31`, isShortYear false, and is refused with FiscalYearOverlaps, FY-003, carrying fiscalYear the world's fiscalYear.
- **a short year of six months is allowed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2027 H1`, yearStartDate `2027-01-01`, yearEndDate `2027-06-30`, isShortYear true, and gets back an answer matching `^fyr_`.
- **so is a short year of one day.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `Q3 day one`, yearStartDate `2027-07-01`, yearEndDate `2027-07-01`, isShortYear true, and gets back an answer matching `^fyr_`.
- **a short year is still judged for overlaps: one from June shares a day with the first half.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2027 H2`, yearStartDate `2027-06-30`, yearEndDate `2027-12-31`, isShortYear true, and is refused with FiscalYearOverlaps, FY-003.
- **a short year inside 2026, April to June, overlaps it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2026 Q2`, yearStartDate `2026-04-01`, yearEndDate `2026-06-30`, isShortYear true, and is refused with FiscalYearOverlaps, FY-003, carrying fiscalYear the world's fiscalYear.
- **a short quarter far ahead, January to March 2045, is allowed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2045 Q1`, yearStartDate `2045-01-01`, yearEndDate `2045-03-31`, isShortYear true, and gets back an answer matching `^fyr_`.
- **a full year from December 2044 that holds that quarter whole overlaps it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2044-2045`, yearStartDate `2044-12-01`, yearEndDate `2045-11-30`, isShortYear false, and is refused with FiscalYearOverlaps, FY-003, carrying fiscalYear the last call's fiscalYear.
- **a short year may run the whole year: it ends no later, so 2050 marked short is allowed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2050`, yearStartDate `2050-01-01`, yearEndDate `2050-12-31`, isShortYear true, and gets back an answer matching `^fyr_`.
- **a year from 28 February 2035 ends on 27 February 2036, though 2036 has a leap day.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2035-2036`, yearStartDate `2035-02-28`, yearEndDate `2036-02-28`, isShortYear false, and is refused with FiscalYearWrongLength, FY-002, carrying yearEndDate `2036-02-27`.
- **a full year may end on a leap day: 1 March 2031 to 29 February 2032.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2031-2032`, yearStartDate `2031-03-01`, yearEndDate `2032-02-29`, isShortYear false, and gets back an answer matching `^fyr_`.
- **from 1 March 2032, with no leap day to come, a year ends on 28 February 2033.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2032-2033`, yearStartDate `2032-03-01`, yearEndDate `2033-02-28`, isShortYear false, and gets back an answer matching `^fyr_`.
- **a year from a leap day ends on 27 February, not the 28th.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2036-2037`, yearStartDate `2036-02-29`, yearEndDate `2037-02-28`, isShortYear false, and is refused with FiscalYearWrongLength, FY-002, carrying yearEndDate `2037-02-27`.
- **on the 27th it is allowed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2036-2037`, yearStartDate `2036-02-29`, yearEndDate `2037-02-27`, isShortYear false, and gets back an answer matching `^fyr_`.
- **a year from 1 March 2039 ends on 29 February 2040, and the 28th is refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, year `2039-2040`, yearStartDate `2039-03-01`, yearEndDate `2040-02-28`, isShortYear false, and is refused with FiscalYearWrongLength, FY-002, carrying yearEndDate `2040-02-29`.
- **Acme Logistics may keep its own 2026, on the same days, under the same name.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, year `2026`, yearStartDate `2026-01-01`, yearEndDate `2026-12-31`, isShortYear false, and gets back an answer matching `^fyr_`.

## How to call

```sh
capxul fiscal-year create --company <company> --year <year> --yearStartDate <yearStartDate> --yearEndDate <yearEndDate> --isShortYear <isShortYear>
```

HTTP: `POST /fiscal-year/create` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.fiscal-year.create(payload)`.

## Worked examples

### draft a payment entry

Starts from the world `an outside supplier`.

- **a draft posts nothing: Debtors' ledger is empty.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's debtors, and gets back 0.
- **and so is Bank's.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's bank, and gets back 0.

### keep the books

Starts from the world `a chart`.

- **Rent's ledger holds one line, the rent's, posted by a journal entry.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's rent, and gets back [[the world's rent, the world's costCenter, `2026-02-01`, `1500000000`, `0`, `Journal Entry`, false]] and gets back an answer matching `^jen_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Rent's ledger keeps the line and its reversal, both marked cancelled.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's rent, and gets back [[the world's rent, the world's costCenter, `2026-02-01`, `1500000000`, `0`, `Journal Entry`, true], [the world's rent, the world's costCenter, `2026-02-01`, `0`, `1500000000`, `Journal Entry`, true]].

### pay a month

Starts from the world `a pension component`.

- **and names the journal entry, whose ledger line on Salaries is the debit.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's salaries, voucherId the last call's items 0 journalEntry, and gets back [[the world's company, the world's salaries, the world's costCenter, `2026-03-31`, `7000000000`, `0`, `Journal Entry`, false]].
- **on Pension Payable the credit.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends account the world's pension, voucherId the last call's items 0 voucherId, and gets back [[the world's company, the world's pension, the world's costCenter, `2026-03-31`, `0`, `300000000`, `Journal Entry`, false]].

### post a journal entry

# goal.archive

Archive a goal: it no longer counts towards its parent or its appraisal.

**Who may call:** the self of its goal.employee, or the owner of its goal.company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 400ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| goal | goal.id |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| goal | goal.id |

## Move

`archive`: from pending or inProgress or closed to archived, emitting GoalArchived.

## Steps

- `goal.archive.load` (database)
- `goal.archive.update` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| GoalCycleCompleted | 41 | GO-001 | declared in errors.ts |
| GoalIsGroup | 47 | GO-007 | declared in errors.ts |
| AppraisalAlreadyExists | 51 | AP-005 | another appraisal holds this employee and appraisal cycle; by the rule appraisal.oneAppraisalPerCycle |
| GoalNotPending | 40 | GO-900 | the goal is in a state archive can't start from; carries `state` |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the self of its goal.employee, or the owner of its goal.company; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### set and track goals

Starts from the world `a started manual cycle`.

- **nor archived.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends goal the last call's items 1 id, and is refused with GoalIsGroup, GO-007.
- **Cy can't archive Olga's Write docs.** `cy` (signed in) calls and sends goal the last call's items 3 id, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **nor can Bo.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends goal the last call's items 3 id, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Olga archives Write docs.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends goal the last call's items 3 id, and is answered.
- **Ada archives the runbook.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends goal the world's secondGoal, and is answered.
- **Olga archives it from pending.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends goal the last call's goal, and is answered.
- **archives it again from closed.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends goal the last call's goal, and is answered.
- **she archives it from in progress.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends goal the last call's goal, and is answered.
- **nor archived.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends goal the last call's items 1 id, and is refused with GoalNotPending, GO-900, carrying state `completed`.
- **archived.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends goal the last call's goal, and is answered.
- **nothing archived.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends goal the last call's items 5 id, and is refused with GoalCycleCompleted, GO-001.

## How to call

```sh
capxul goal archive --goal <goal>
```

HTTP: `POST /goal/archive` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.goal.archive(payload)`.

### appraise a year

Starts from the world `a second feedback criteria`.

# goal

Something an employee aims to do in an appraisal cycle, under one KRA.

Lives in the database.

## Fields

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| id | id |  |
| company | company.id |  |
| employee | employee.id |  |
| appraisalCycle | appraisal-cycle.id |  |
| kra | kra.id |  |
| goalName | GoalName |  |
| progress | Progress |  |
| isGroup | YesNo | Whether the goal holds other goals, its progress following theirs (HRMS's `is_group`). |
| parentGoal (optional) | goal.id |  |

## Machine

States: pending, inProgress, completed, archived, closed. A move from the wrong state is refused GoalNotPending (exit 40).

| move | from | to | emits |
|---|---|---|---|
| create | (creates) | pending, inProgress, completed | GoalCreated |
| updateProgress | pending, inProgress, completed, archived, closed | pending, inProgress, completed, archived, closed | GoalProgressUpdated |
| complete | pending, inProgress | completed | GoalCompleted |
| archive | pending, inProgress, closed | archived | GoalArchived |
| close | pending, inProgress, archived | closed | GoalClosed |
| unarchive | archived | pending, inProgress, completed | GoalUnarchived |
| reopen | closed | pending, inProgress, completed | GoalReopened |
| rollUp | pending, inProgress, completed | pending, inProgress, completed | GoalRolledUp |

## Events

- `GoalArchived`: carries goal (goal.id); emitted by the move archive
- `GoalClosed`: carries goal (goal.id); emitted by the move close
- `GoalCompleted`: carries goal (goal.id); emitted by the move complete
- `GoalCreated`: carries goal (goal.id), employee (goal.employee), kra (goal.kra); emitted by the move create
- `GoalProgressUpdated`: carries goal (goal.id); emitted by the move updateProgress
- `GoalReopened`: carries goal (goal.id); emitted by the move reopen
- `GoalRolledUp`: carries goal (goal.id); emitted by the move rollUp
- `GoalUnarchived`: carries goal (goal.id); emitted by the move unarchive

## Operations

- [goal.archive](archive.md): Archive a goal: it no longer counts towards its parent or its appraisal.
- [goal.close](close.md): Close a goal, keeping its progress.
- [goal.complete](complete.md): Mark a goal completed, setting its progress to 100.
- [goal.create](create.md): Set an employee a goal in a cycle, under a KRA, perhaps under another of their goals.
- [goal.get](get.md): Read one goal by its id: company, employee, appraisalCycle, kra, goalName, progress, isGroup, state.
- [goal.list](list.md): List goals, oldest first, 50 to a page, filtered by appraisalCycle, employee.
- [goal.reopen](reopen.md): Reopen a closed goal: its status follows its progress again.
- [goal.roll-up](roll-up.md): Bring a group goal's status up to date with the progress its children have rolled up.
- [goal.unarchive](unarchive.md): Bring an archived goal back: its status follows its progress again.
- [goal.update-progress](update-progress.md): Set how far along a goal is, from 0 to 100.

# holiday-list.add-weekly-off

Make every given weekday in a holiday list a day off.

**Who may call:** the owner of its holidayList.company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 300ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| holidayList | holiday-list.id |
| weekday | Weekday |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| holidayList | holiday-list.id |
| weekday | Weekday |
| added | HolidayCount |
| totalHolidays | HolidayCount |

## Move

`addWeeklyOff`: from active to active, emitting WeeklyOffAdded.

## Steps

- `holiday-list.add-weekly-off.load` (database)
- `holiday-list.add-weekly-off.record` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| HolidayDateTaken | 41 | HD-001 | another holiday holds this holiday list and holiday date; by the rule holiday.oneHolidayPerDay, carrying holidayDate |
| HolidayListNameTaken | 43 | HL-001 | another holiday list holds this company and holiday list name; by the rule holiday-list.oneNamePerCompany, carrying holidayListName |
| HolidayListNotActive | 40 | HL-900 | the holiday-list is in a state addWeeklyOff can't start from; carries `state` |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its holidayList.company; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### a one-day list

Starts from the world `a one-day list`.

- **a weekday the list doesn't hold adds nothing.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, weekday `Sunday`, and gets back [`0`, `0`].
- **its own weekday adds its one day.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, weekday `Monday`, and gets back [`1`, `1`].

### every weekday

Starts from the world `a leap fortnight`.

- **the weekday the list starts and ends on adds three, the leap day among them.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, weekday `Tuesday`, and gets back [`3`, `3`].
- **the day after it adds two.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, weekday `Wednesday`, and gets back [`2`, `5`].
- **the third weekday adds two.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, weekday `Thursday`, and gets back [`2`, `7`].
- **the fourth weekday adds two.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, weekday `Friday`, and gets back [`2`, `9`].
- **the fifth weekday adds two.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, weekday `Saturday`, and gets back [`2`, `11`].
- **the sixth weekday adds two.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, weekday `Sunday`, and gets back [`2`, `13`].
- **the last weekday adds two.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, weekday `Monday`, and gets back [`2`, `15`].

### weekly offs

Starts from the world `a sunday holiday`.

- **Bo can't add a weekly off to Ada's list.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, weekday `Sunday`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Ada makes a weekday a day off, and the day the list already held is skipped.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, weekday `Sunday`, and gets back [the world's holidayList, `Sunday`, `51`, `52`].
- **a weekday that falls on both the first and the last day counts both.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, weekday `Friday`, and gets back [`Friday`, `53`, `105`].
- **asking for the same weekday again adds nothing.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends holidayList the world's holidayList, weekday `Friday`, and gets back [`0`, `105`].

## How to call

```sh
capxul holiday-list add-weekly-off --holidayList <holidayList> --weekday <weekday>
```

HTTP: `POST /holiday-list/add-weekly-off` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.holiday-list.add-weekly-off(payload)`.

### leave days

Starts from the world `a leave allocation`.

- **Ada looks up Kenya 2027.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, holidayListName `KE-27`, fromDate `2027-01-01`, toDate `2027-12-31`, with the request key `kenya`, and gets back an answer matching `^hls_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Ada looks up Kenya 2027 again.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, holidayListName `KE-27`, fromDate `2027-01-01`, toDate `2027-12-31`, with the request key `kenya`, and gets back an answer matching `^hls_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Ada looks up Kenya 2027 a third time.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, holidayListName `KE-27`, fromDate `2027-01-01`, toDate `2027-12-31`, with the request key `kenya`, and gets back an answer matching `^hls_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Ada starts a second list, Coast June, for June 2027 alone.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, holidayListName `COAST-06`, fromDate `2027-06-01`, toDate `2027-06-30`, and gets back an answer matching `^hls_[0-9a-z]+$`.

# interview-feedback.give

Give an interviewer's feedback on an interview: cleared or rejected.

**Who may call:** the self of its interviewer.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 150ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| interview | interview-feedback.interview |
| interviewer | interview-feedback.interviewer |
| result | interview-feedback.result |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| interviewFeedback | interview-feedback.id |

## Move

`give`: from nothing (it creates) to given, emitting InterviewFeedbackGiven.

## Steps

- `interview-feedback.give.load` (database)
- `interview-feedback.give.insert` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| FeedbackGiverNotInterviewer | 41 | IF-001 | declared in errors.ts |
| FeedbackBeforeInterview | 42 | IF-002 | declared in errors.ts, carrying scheduledOn |
| FeedbackAlreadyGiven | 43 | IF-003 | another interview feedback holds this interview and interviewer; by the rule interview-feedback.oneFeedbackPerInterviewer |
| InterviewNotFound | 4 | IV-901 | nothing has the id in interview; the handler never runs; carries `id` |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the self of its interviewer; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### give interview feedback

Starts from the world `an interview`.

- **Olga can't give feedback two days before the interview.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's employee, result `Cleared`, and is refused with FeedbackBeforeInterview, IF-002, carrying scheduledOn `2026-12-03`.
- **Ada can't give it for her.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's employee, result `Cleared`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **nor can Bo.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's employee, result `Rejected`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Bo can't give his own: he isn't one of its interviewers, which is judged before the day.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's outsider, result `Rejected`, and is refused with FeedbackGiverNotInterviewer, IF-001.
- **Olga still can't give it.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's employee, result `Cleared`, and is refused with FeedbackBeforeInterview, IF-002, carrying scheduledOn `2026-12-03`.
- **nor can Cy.** `cy` (signed in) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's secondEmployee, result `Rejected`, and is refused with FeedbackBeforeInterview, IF-002, carrying scheduledOn `2026-12-03`.
- **Bo still can't give his own.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's outsider, result `Cleared`, and is refused with FeedbackGiverNotInterviewer, IF-001.
- **Olga clears Pat, on the day itself.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's employee, result `Cleared`, and gets back an answer matching `^ifb_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Olga can't give a second, even another result.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's employee, result `Rejected`, and is refused with FeedbackAlreadyGiven, IF-003.
- **Olga can't give feedback on that one yet: its own day is judged.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends interview the last call's interview, interviewer the world's employee, result `Cleared`, and is refused with FeedbackBeforeInterview, IF-002, carrying scheduledOn `2026-12-05`.
- **nor Cy.** `cy` (signed in) calls and sends interview the last call's interview, interviewer the world's secondEmployee, result `Cleared`, and is refused with FeedbackBeforeInterview, IF-002, carrying scheduledOn `2026-12-05`.
- **Cy can't give feedback on it: she isn't one of its interviewers.** `cy` (signed in) calls and sends interview the last call's interview, interviewer the world's secondEmployee, result `Cleared`, and is refused with FeedbackGiverNotInterviewer, IF-001.
- **Olga, who gave feedback on the technical interview, may still give it on the cleared final one.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends interview the last call's interview, interviewer the world's employee, result `Rejected`, and gets back an answer matching `^ifb_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Cy, who has left, still gives her feedback on the technical interview she was on, still pending.** `cy` (signed in) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's secondEmployee, result `Rejected`, and gets back an answer matching `^ifb_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Cy can't give a second.** `cy` (signed in) calls and sends interview the world's interview, interviewer the world's secondEmployee, result `Cleared`, and is refused with FeedbackAlreadyGiven, IF-003.

### hire from a job opening

Starts from the world `a technical round`.

- **Olga clears Pat the same day.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends interview the last call's interview, interviewer the world's employee, result `Cleared`, and gets back an answer matching `^ifb_[0-9a-z]+$`.

## How to call

```sh
capxul interview-feedback give --interview <interview> --interviewer <interviewer> --result <result>
```

- **Ada adds the final round.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, roundName `Final`, interviewers [], and gets back an answer matching `^irn_[0-9a-z]+$`.

### schedule an interview

Starts from the world `an outside employee`.

- **Ada adds a technical round to Acme Logistics.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, roundName `Technical`, interviewers [the world's outsider], and gets back an answer matching `^irn_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Ada adds a culture round, with nobody.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, roundName `Culture`, interviewers [], and gets back an answer matching `^irn_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Ada adds the final round, with Cy.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, roundName `Final`, interviewers [the world's secondEmployee], and gets back an answer matching `^irn_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **and adds a panel round to Acme Logistics.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, roundName `Panel`, interviewers [the world's outsider], and gets back an answer matching `^irn_[0-9a-z]+$`.

Starts from the world `an outside employee`.

- **Ada can't add a second technical round.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, roundName `Technical`, interviewers [the world's secondEmployee], and is refused with RoundNameTaken, IR-001, carrying roundName `Technical`.
- **Ada adds a panel round, with Cy then Olga.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, roundName `Panel`, interviewers [the world's secondEmployee, the world's employee], and gets back an answer matching `^irn_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Ada adds a culture round, in lower case, with nobody yet.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, roundName `culture`, interviewers [], and gets back an answer matching `^irn_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Acme Logistics may have its own technical round, with Bo.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, roundName `Technical`, interviewers [the world's outsider], and gets back an answer matching `^irn_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Dee's company may have its own technical round too.** `dee` (signed in) calls and sends company the last call's company, roundName `Technical`, interviewers [], and gets back an answer matching `^irn_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Ada can't put Bo on an Acme Trading round: he works for Acme Logistics, though she runs both.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, roundName `Final`, interviewers [the world's outsider], and is refused with RoundInterviewerNotInCompany, IR-002.
- **nor after Olga.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, roundName `Final`, interviewers [the world's employee, the world's outsider], and is refused with RoundInterviewerNotInCompany, IR-002.
- **nor put Olga on an Acme Logistics round.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, roundName `Final`, interviewers [the world's outsider, the world's employee], and is refused with RoundInterviewerNotInCompany, IR-002.
- **Ada can't put Olga on a new round now she has left.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, roundName `Final`, interviewers [the world's employee], and is refused with RoundInterviewerHasLeft, IR-003.
- **nor after Cy.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, roundName `Final`, interviewers [the world's secondEmployee, the world's employee], and is refused with RoundInterviewerHasLeft, IR-003.
- **Olga gone and Bo from another company is refused for Bo first, though Olga comes first.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, roundName `Final`, interviewers [the world's employee, the world's outsider], and is refused with RoundInterviewerNotInCompany, IR-002.
- **Ada adds the final round, with Cy alone.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, roundName `Final`, interviewers [the world's secondEmployee], and gets back an answer matching `^irn_[0-9a-z]+$`.

## How to call

```sh
capxul interview-round create --company <company> --roundName <roundName> --interviewers <interviewers>
```

# interview.reject

Mark an interview rejected.

**Who may call:** the owner of its interview.company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 150ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| interview | interview.id |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| interview | interview.id |

## Move

`reject`: from pending to rejected, emitting InterviewRejected.

- `interview.reject.update` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| InterviewAlreadyScheduled | 46 | IV-006 | another interview holds this job applicant and interview round; by the rule interview.oneInterviewPerRound |
| InterviewNotPending | 40 | IV-900 | the interview is in a state reject can't start from; carries `state` |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its interview.company; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### give interview feedback

Starts from the world `an interview`.

- **Ada marks the technical interview rejected, though Olga cleared Pat.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends interview the world's interview, and gets back the world's interview.

### schedule an interview

Starts from the world `an outside employee`.

- **Bo can't reject it.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends interview the last call's interview, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Ada marks it rejected.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends interview the last call's interview, and gets back an answer matching `^ivw_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **nor rejected again.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends interview the last call's interview, and is refused with InterviewNotPending, IV-900, carrying state `rejected`.
- **it can't then be rejected.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends interview the last call's interview, and is refused with InterviewNotPending, IV-900, carrying state `cleared`.

```sh
capxul interview reject --interview <interview>
```

- **Salaries is debited and credited on lines of their own, not netted; the credits in the order the slip meets them.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends journalEntry the last call's journalEntry, and gets back [[`1`, the world's salaries, the world's costCenter, `3000000000`, `0`], [`2`, the world's salaries, the world's costCenter, `0`, `50000000`], [`3`, the world's pension, the world's costCenter, `0`, `150000000`], [`4`, the world's payable, the world's costCenter, `0`, `2800000000`]].
- **the credits follow the other structure's order.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends journalEntry the last call's journalEntry, and gets back [[`1`, the world's salaries, the world's costCenter, `3000000000`, `0`], [`2`, the world's pension, the world's costCenter, `0`, `150000000`], [`3`, the world's salaries, the world's costCenter, `0`, `50000000`], [`4`, the world's payable, the world's costCenter, `0`, `2800000000`]].
- **the debits come in the order the slip meets their accounts: Rent, then Salaries.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends journalEntry the last call's journalEntry, and gets back [[`1`, the world's rent, the world's costCenter, `100000000`, `0`], [`2`, the world's salaries, the world's costCenter, `3000000000`, `0`], [`3`, the world's payable, the world's costCenter, `0`, `3100000000`]].
- **and the other way round: Salaries, then Rent.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends journalEntry the last call's journalEntry, and gets back [[`1`, the world's salaries, the world's costCenter, `3000000000`, `0`], [`2`, the world's rent, the world's costCenter, `100000000`, `0`], [`3`, the world's payable, the world's costCenter, `0`, `3100000000`]].

## How to call

```sh
capxul journal-entry-account list [--journalEntry <journalEntry>] [--cursor <cursor>]
```

HTTP: `POST /journal-entry-account/list` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.journal-entry-account.list(payload)`.

# journal-entry.cancel

Cancel a submitted journal entry, posting a reversing ledger line for each it posted.

**Who may call:** the owner of its journalEntry.company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 300ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| journalEntry | journal-entry.id |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| journalEntry | journal-entry.id |
| reversed | LineCount |

## Move

`cancel`: from submitted to cancelled, emitting JournalEntryCancelled.

## Steps

- `journal-entry.cancel.load` (database)
- `journal-entry.cancel.reverse` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| JournalEntryNotDraft | 40 | JE-900 | the journal-entry is in a state cancel can't start from; carries `state` |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its journalEntry.company; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### keep the books

Starts from the world `a chart`.

- **Ada cancels the rent entry, the voucher that line names: two reversing lines.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends journalEntry the last call's items 0 voucherId, and gets back `2`.

### post a journal entry

Starts from the world `a capital entry`.

- **Ada can't cancel it while it is a draft.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends journalEntry the world's journalEntry, and is refused with JournalEntryNotDraft, JE-900, carrying state `draft`.
- **Bo can't cancel it.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends journalEntry the world's journalEntry, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Ada cancels it: two reversing lines.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends journalEntry the world's journalEntry, and gets back [the world's journalEntry, `2`].
- **it can't be cancelled twice.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends journalEntry the world's journalEntry, and is refused with JournalEntryNotDraft, JE-900, carrying state `cancelled`.
- **Ada cancels it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends journalEntry the last call's items 0 voucherId, and gets back `2`.

## How to call

```sh
capxul journal-entry cancel --journalEntry <journalEntry>
```

HTTP: `POST /journal-entry/cancel` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.journal-entry.cancel(payload)`.

# journal-entry

A company's own entry in its books: lines debiting and crediting accounts, posted to the ledger when submitted.

Lives in the database.

## Fields

| field | value |
|---|---|
| id | id |
| company | company.id |
| postingDate | Day |
| userRemark | Remark |
| totalDebit | Amount |
| totalCredit | Amount |

## Machine

States: draft, submitted, cancelled. A move from the wrong state is refused JournalEntryNotDraft (exit 40).

| move | from | to | emits |
|---|---|---|---|
| create | (creates) | draft | JournalEntryDrafted |
| submit | draft | submitted | JournalEntrySubmitted |
| cancel | submitted | cancelled | JournalEntryCancelled |

# leave-application

An employee's ask for leave of one type, from one day to another.

Lives in the database.

## Fields

| field | value |
|---|---|
| id | id |
| company | company.id |
| employee | employee.id |
| leaveType | leave-type.id |

| toDate | Day |
| reason | LeaveReason |
| totalLeaveDays | LeaveDays |

## Machine

States: open, approved, rejected, cancelled. A move from the wrong state is refused LeaveApplicationNotOpen (exit 40).

| move | from | to | emits |
|---|---|---|---|
| create | (creates) | open | LeaveApplied |
| approve | open | approved | LeaveApplicationApproved |
| reject | open | rejected | LeaveApplicationRejected |
| cancel | open, approved | cancelled | LeaveApplicationCancelled |

## Events

- `LeaveApplicationApproved`: carries leaveApplication (leave-application.id), marked (DayCount), changed (DayCount); emitted by the move approve
- `LeaveApplicationCancelled`: carries leaveApplication (leave-application.id); emitted by the move cancel
- `LeaveApplicationRejected`: carries leaveApplication (leave-application.id); emitted by the move reject
- `LeaveApplied`: carries leaveApplication (leave-application.id), company (leave-application.company), employee (leave-application.employee), leaveType (leave-application.leaveType); emitted by the move create

## Operations

- [leave-application.approve](approve.md): Approve a leave, marking each of its days On Leave.
- [leave-application.cancel](cancel.md): Cancel a leave, open or approved.
- [leave-application.create](create.md): Ask for leave of one type, from one day to another, and why.
- [leave-application.get](get.md): Read one leave-application by its id: company, employee, leaveType, fromDate, toDate, reason, totalLeaveDays, state.
- [leave-application.reject](reject.md): Reject a leave, marking none of its days.

# leave-application.reject

Reject a leave, marking none of its days.

**Who may call:** the owner of its leaveApplication.company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 150ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| leaveApplication | leave-application.id |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| leaveApplication | leave-application.id |

## Move

`reject`: from open to rejected, emitting LeaveApplicationRejected.

## Steps

- `leave-application.reject.update` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| LeaveApplicationNotOpen | 40 | LP-900 | the leave-application is in a state reject can't start from; carries `state` |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its leaveApplication.company; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### overlapping leave

Starts from the world `a leave application`.

- **Ada rejects them.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends leaveApplication the last call's leaveApplication, and is answered.

### take leave

Starts from the world `a leave allocation`.

- **nor can Olga reject it.** `olga` (signed in) calls and sends leaveApplication the last call's leaveApplication, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **nor rejected once approved.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends leaveApplication the last call's leaveApplication, and is refused with LeaveApplicationNotOpen, LP-900, carrying state `approved`.
- **Ada rejects it: no day is marked.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends leaveApplication the last call's leaveApplication, and gets back an answer matching `^lap_[0-9a-z]+$`.

## How to call

```sh
capxul leave-application reject --leaveApplication <leaveApplication>
```

HTTP: `POST /leave-application/reject` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.leave-application.reject(payload)`.

# payment-entry.cancel

Cancel a submitted payment, posting a reversing ledger line for each it posted.

**Who may call:** the owner of its paymentEntry.company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

| field | value |
|---|---|
| paymentEntry | payment-entry.id |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| paymentEntry | payment-entry.id |
| reversed | LineCount |

## Move

`cancel`: from submitted to cancelled, emitting PaymentEntryCancelled.

## Steps

- `payment-entry.cancel.load` (database)
- `payment-entry.cancel.reverse` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| PartyDisabled | 50 | PY-010 | declared in errors.ts |
| PaymentEntryNotDraft | 40 | PY-900 | the payment-entry is in a state cancel can't start from; carries `state` |

## Worked examples

### post a payment entry

Starts from the world `a received advance`.

- **Ada can't cancel it while it is a draft.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the world's paymentEntry, and is refused with PaymentEntryNotDraft, PY-900, carrying state `draft`.
- **Bo can't cancel it.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends paymentEntry the world's paymentEntry, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Ada cancels it: two reversing lines.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the world's paymentEntry, and gets back [the world's paymentEntry, `2`].
- **it can't be cancelled twice.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the world's paymentEntry, and is refused with PaymentEntryNotDraft, PY-900, carrying state `cancelled`.
- **and cancels it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the last call's paymentEntry, and gets back `2`.
- **that payment can't be cancelled while its supplier is disabled.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the last call's items 0 voucherId, and is refused with PartyDisabled, PY-010.

## How to call

```sh
capxul payment-entry cancel --paymentEntry <paymentEntry>
```

HTTP: `POST /payment-entry/cancel` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.payment-entry.cancel(payload)`.

# payment-entry

Money a company receives from a customer or supplier, or pays to one, posted to the ledger when submitted.

Lives in the database.

| paidAmount | Amount |

## Machine

States: draft, submitted, cancelled. A move from the wrong state is refused PaymentEntryNotDraft (exit 40).

| move | from | to | emits |
|---|---|---|---|
| create | (creates) | draft | PaymentEntryDrafted |
| submit | draft | submitted | PaymentEntrySubmitted |
| cancel | submitted | cancelled | PaymentEntryCancelled |

## Events

- `PaymentEntryCancelled`: carries paymentEntry (payment-entry.id), reversed (LineCount); emitted by the move cancel
- `PaymentEntryDrafted`: carries paymentEntry (payment-entry.id), company (payment-entry.company), paymentType (payment-entry.paymentType), partyType (payment-entry.partyType), party (payment-entry.party), paidAmount (payment-entry.paidAmount); emitted by the move create
- `PaymentEntrySubmitted`: carries paymentEntry (payment-entry.id), posted (LineCount); emitted by the move submit

## Operations

- [payment-entry.cancel](cancel.md): Cancel a submitted payment, posting a reversing ledger line for each it posted.
- [payment-entry.create](create.md): Draft a payment received from a party or paid to one, with no invoice: an advance.
- [payment-entry.get](get.md): Read one payment-entry by its id: company, paymentType, postingDate, partyType, party, paidFrom, paidTo, paidAmount, costCenter, state.
- [payment-entry.submit](submit.md): Submit a payment, posting the party's ledger line and the bank's.

# payment-entry.submit

**Who may call:** the owner of its paymentEntry.company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

| field | value |
|---|---|

| field | value |
|---|---|

`submit`: from draft to submitted, emitting PaymentEntrySubmitted.

- `payment-entry.submit.post` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| PaymentPostingDateOutsideFiscalYear | 49 | PY-009 | declared in errors.ts, carrying postingDate |
| PartyDisabled | 50 | PY-010 | declared in errors.ts |

### post a payment entry

Starts from the world `a received advance`.

- **Ada submits it: two ledger lines.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the world's paymentEntry, and gets back [the world's paymentEntry, `2`].
- **Ada can't submit it twice.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the world's paymentEntry, and is refused with PaymentEntryNotDraft, PY-900, carrying state `submitted`.
- **nor submitted again.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the world's paymentEntry, and is refused with PaymentEntryNotDraft, PY-900, carrying state `cancelled`.
- **and submits it: two ledger lines.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the last call's paymentEntry, and gets back `2`.
- **Ada submits it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the last call's paymentEntry, and gets back `2`.
- **Ada submits it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the last call's paymentEntry, and gets back `2`.
- **and submits it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the last call's paymentEntry, and gets back `2`.
- **submitted.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the last call's paymentEntry, and gets back `2`.
- **it can't be submitted: the day is in none of Acme Trading's fiscal years.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the last call's paymentEntry, and is refused with PaymentPostingDateOutsideFiscalYear, PY-009, carrying postingDate `2025-12-31`.
- **refused the same way.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the last call's paymentEntry, and is refused with PaymentPostingDateOutsideFiscalYear, PY-009, carrying postingDate `2027-01-01`.
- **another company's year doesn't count.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the last call's paymentEntry, and is refused with PaymentPostingDateOutsideFiscalYear, PY-009, carrying postingDate `2027-03-01`.
- **submitted.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the last call's paymentEntry, and gets back `2`.
- **submitted.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the last call's paymentEntry, and gets back `2`.
- **posts, though its calendar year is 2029.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the last call's paymentEntry, and gets back `2`.

- **is refused too.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the last call's paymentEntry, and is refused with PaymentPostingDateOutsideFiscalYear, PY-009, carrying postingDate `2029-03-15`.
- **but not submitted: the fiscal year is judged before the party.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the last call's paymentEntry, and is refused with PaymentPostingDateOutsideFiscalYear, PY-009, carrying postingDate `2027-01-04`.
- **but not submitted: Mara Office Rentals is disabled.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the last call's paymentEntry, and is refused with PartyDisabled, PY-010.
- **now it submits.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the last call's paymentEntry, and gets back `2`.
- **submitted.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends paymentEntry the last call's paymentEntry, and gets back `2`.

# payroll-entry

A company's pay run for a span of days: its employees' salary slips, and the journal entry that books them.

Lives in the database.

## Fields

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| id | id |  |
| company | company.id |  |
| postingDate | Day | The day its salary slips and accrual journal entry are posted. |
| startDate | Day |  |
| endDate | Day |  |
| costCenter | cost-center.id |  |
| payrollPayableAccount | account.id | The ledger the net pay is credited to, owed to the employees until it is paid. |
| numberOfEmployees | EmployeeCount |  |

## Machine

States: draft, submitted, accrued. A move from the wrong state is refused PayrollEntryNotDraft (exit 40).

| move | from | to | emits |
|---|---|---|---|
| create | (creates) | draft | PayrollEntryDrafted |
| submit | draft | submitted | PayrollEntrySubmitted |
| submitSlips | submitted | accrued | SalarySlipsSubmitted |

## Events

- `PayrollEntryDrafted`: carries payrollEntry (payroll-entry.id), company (payroll-entry.company), numberOfEmployees (payroll-entry.numberOfEmployees); emitted by the move create
- `PayrollEntrySubmitted`: carries payrollEntry (payroll-entry.id), slips (EmployeeCount); emitted by the move submit
- `SalarySlipsSubmitted`: carries payrollEntry (payroll-entry.id), journalEntry (journal-entry.id), slips (EmployeeCount); emitted by the move submitSlips

## Operations

- [payroll-entry.create](create.md): Draft a payroll entry for a span of days, filled with the company's employees to pay.
- [payroll-entry.get](get.md): Read one payroll-entry by its id: company, postingDate, startDate, endDate, costCenter, payrollPayableAccount, numberOfEmployees, state.
- [payroll-entry.list](list.md): List payroll-entrys, oldest first, 50 to a page, filtered by company.
- [payroll-entry.submit](submit.md): Submit a payroll entry, making a draft salary slip for each of its employees.
- [payroll-entry.submit-slips](submit-slips.md): Submit a payroll entry's salary slips, booking their pay in one accrual journal entry.

# payroll-period.create

Set up a company's payroll period.

**Who may call:** the owner of its company.

**Idempotent by request:** send `idempotency-key`; the same key twice is one call.

**Budget:** p95 150ms.

## Payload

| field | value |
|---|---|
| company | payroll-period.company |
| payrollPeriodName | payroll-period.payrollPeriodName |
| startDate | payroll-period.startDate |
| endDate | payroll-period.endDate |

## Answer

| field | value |
|---|---|
| payrollPeriod | payroll-period.id |

## Move

`create`: from nothing (it creates) to active, emitting PayrollPeriodCreated.

## Steps

- `payroll-period.create.load` (database)
- `payroll-period.create.insert` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| PayrollPeriodEndsBeforeStart | 41 | PP-001 | declared in errors.ts, carrying startDate |
| PayrollPeriodOverlaps | 42 | PP-002 | declared in errors.ts, carrying payrollPeriod |
| PayrollPeriodNameTaken | 43 | PP-003 | another payroll period holds this company and payroll period name; by the rule payroll-period.oneNamePerCompany |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its company; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### pay a month

Starts from the world `a pension component`.

- **Ada sets up the payroll period 2026.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, payrollPeriodName `2026`, startDate `2026-01-01`, endDate `2026-12-31`, and is answered.

### set up payroll periods

Starts from the world `two companies`.

- **Bo can't set up a period for Acme Trading.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends company the world's company, payrollPeriodName `2026`, startDate `2026-01-01`, endDate `2026-12-31`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **a period ending before it starts is refused, naming its first day.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, payrollPeriodName `Backwards`, startDate `2026-12-31`, endDate `2026-12-30`, and is refused with PayrollPeriodEndsBeforeStart, PP-001, carrying startDate `2026-12-31`.
- **Ada sets up 2026, from April 2026 to March 2027.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, payrollPeriodName `2026`, startDate `2026-04-01`, endDate `2027-03-31`, and is answered.
- **a one-day period is allowed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, payrollPeriodName `Audit day`, startDate `2027-04-01`, endDate `2027-04-01`, and is answered.
- **a period sharing only 2026's last day is refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, payrollPeriodName `Overlap end`, startDate `2027-03-31`, endDate `2027-03-31`, and is refused with PayrollPeriodOverlaps, PP-002.
- **one ending on 2026's first day too.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, payrollPeriodName `Overlap start`, startDate `2026-03-01`, endDate `2026-04-01`, and is refused with PayrollPeriodOverlaps, PP-002.
- **one inside it too.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, payrollPeriodName `Inside`, startDate `2026-06-01`, endDate `2026-06-30`, and is refused with PayrollPeriodOverlaps, PP-002.
- **but one ending the day before it is allowed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, payrollPeriodName `2025`, startDate `2025-04-01`, endDate `2026-03-31`, and is answered.
- **one holding 2025, 2026 and the audit day names 2025, which starts first.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, payrollPeriodName `Everything`, startDate `2025-01-01`, endDate `2027-12-31`, and is refused with PayrollPeriodOverlaps, PP-002, carrying payrollPeriod the last call's payrollPeriod.
- **a period ending before it starts is judged before an overlap.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, payrollPeriodName `Backwards`, startDate `2026-06-30`, endDate `2026-06-01`, and is refused with PayrollPeriodEndsBeforeStart, PP-001, carrying startDate `2026-06-30`.
- **a name already used is refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, payrollPeriodName `2026`, startDate `2030-01-01`, endDate `2030-12-31`, and is refused with PayrollPeriodNameTaken, PP-003.
- **an overlap is judged before a name.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, payrollPeriodName `2026`, startDate `2026-05-01`, endDate `2026-05-31`, and is refused with PayrollPeriodOverlaps, PP-002.
- **Acme Logistics may have its own 2026 over the same days: each company's periods are its own.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, payrollPeriodName `2026`, startDate `2026-04-01`, endDate `2027-03-31`, and is answered.

## How to call

```sh
capxul payroll-period create --company <company> --payrollPeriodName <payrollPeriodName> --startDate <startDate> --endDate <endDate>
```

HTTP: `POST /payroll-period/create` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.payroll-period.create(payload)`.

### run a payroll

### set up salary components

Starts from the world `a salaries ledger`.

- **Bo can't add a component to Acme Trading.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends company the world's company, salaryComponent `Basic`, type `Earning`, amount `3000000000`, account the world's salaries, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.

- **a name already used in the company is refused, whatever its type.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, salaryComponent `Basic`, type `Deduction`, amount `5000000`, account the world's pension, and is refused with SalaryComponentTaken, SC-003.
- **Acme Trading's component booked to that group is refused for the company, before the group.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, salaryComponent `Overtime`, type `Earning`, amount `0`, account the last call's account, and is refused with ComponentAccountNotInCompany, SC-001.
- **Acme Trading's component can't be booked to Acme Logistics' ledger.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, salaryComponent `Overtime`, type `Earning`, amount `0`, account the last call's account, and is refused with ComponentAccountNotInCompany, SC-001.
- **another company's account is refused before a name already taken.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, salaryComponent `Basic`, type `Earning`, amount `0`, account the last call's account, and is refused with ComponentAccountNotInCompany, SC-001.
- **and a group before a name already taken.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, salaryComponent `Basic`, type `Earning`, amount `0`, account the world's operating, and is refused with ComponentAccountIsGroup, SC-002.
- **Acme Logistics may have its own Basic, booked to its own ledger.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, salaryComponent `Basic`, type `Earning`, amount `1000000000`, account the last call's account, and is answered.
- **but not booked to Acme Trading's Salaries.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, salaryComponent `Housing`, type `Earning`, amount `0`, account the world's salaries, and is refused with ComponentAccountNotInCompany, SC-001.

### set up salary structures

Starts from the world `a pension component`.

- **and gives Acme Logistics its own Basic.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, salaryComponent `Basic`, type `Earning`, amount `1000000000`, account the last call's account, and is answered.
- **Ada adds an earning with no default.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, salaryComponent `Overtime`, type `Earning`, amount `0`, account the world's salaries, and is answered.

- **then cancels it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends salaryStructureAssignment the last call's salaryStructureAssignment, and is answered.

### run a payroll

States: draft, submitted, cancelled. A move from the wrong state is refused SalaryStructureAssignmentNotDraft (exit 40).

| move | from | to | emits |
|---|---|---|---|
| create | (creates) | draft | SalaryStructureAssigned |
| submit | draft | submitted | SalaryStructureAssignmentSubmitted |
| cancel | submitted | cancelled | SalaryStructureAssignmentCancelled |

## Events

- `SalaryStructureAssigned`: carries salaryStructureAssignment (salary-structure-assignment.id), employee (salary-structure-assignment.employee), salaryStructure (salary-structure-assignment.salaryStructure), fromDate (salary-structure-assignment.fromDate: The first day the structure pays the employee.); emitted by the move create
- `SalaryStructureAssignmentCancelled`: carries salaryStructureAssignment (salary-structure-assignment.id); emitted by the move cancel
- `SalaryStructureAssignmentSubmitted`: carries salaryStructureAssignment (salary-structure-assignment.id); emitted by the move submit

## Operations

- [salary-structure-assignment.cancel](cancel.md): Cancel a submitted assignment, so payroll no longer counts it.
- [salary-structure-assignment.create](create.md): Assign a salary structure to an employee from a day on.
- [salary-structure-assignment.get](get.md): Read one salary-structure-assignment by its id: company, employee, salaryStructure, fromDate, state.
- [salary-structure-assignment.list](list.md): List salary-structure-assignments, oldest first, 50 to a page, filtered by employee.
- [salary-structure-assignment.submit](submit.md): Submit an assignment, so payroll pays the employee by its structure from its day on.

Cancel a submitted salary structure no assignment or salary slip uses.

**Who may call:** the owner of its salaryStructure.company.

| field | value |

## Steps

- `salary-structure.cancel.update` (database)

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| StructureInUse | 47 | SS-007 | declared in errors.ts |
| SalaryStructureNameTaken | 48 | SS-008 | another salary structure holds this company and salary structure name; by the rule salary-structure.oneNamePerCompany |
| SalaryStructureNotDraft | 40 | SS-900 | the salary-structure is in a state cancel can't start from; carries `state` |

## Worked examples

### assign salary structures

Starts from the world `a payroll outsider`.

- **a draft assignment doesn't keep the structure in use: Ada cancels it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends salaryStructure the last call's salaryStructure, and is answered.
- **a cancelled assignment doesn't keep the structure in use: Ada cancels it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends salaryStructure the last call's salaryStructure, and is answered.
- **the interim structure is used only by a draft, so Ada can cancel it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends salaryStructure the last call's items 4 salaryStructure, and is answered.

### pay a month

Starts from the world `a pension component`.

- **a structure an assignment uses can't be cancelled.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends salaryStructure the last call's salaryStructure, and is refused with StructureInUse, SS-007.

### run a payroll

Starts from the world `an outside cost center`.

- **no submitted assignment uses that structure now, but its slips do: it can't be cancelled.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends salaryStructure the last call's salaryStructure, and is refused with StructureInUse, SS-007.

### set up salary structures

Starts from the world `a pension component`.

- **a draft can't be cancelled.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends salaryStructure the last call's salaryStructure, and is refused with SalaryStructureNotDraft, SS-900, carrying state `draft`.
- **Bo can't cancel it.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends salaryStructure the last call's items 0 salaryStructure, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **nothing uses it, so Ada cancels it.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends salaryStructure the last call's items 0 salaryStructure, and is answered.
- **it can't be cancelled twice.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends salaryStructure the last call's salaryStructure, and is refused with SalaryStructureNotDraft, SS-900, carrying state `cancelled`.

## Answer

| field | value | description |
|---|---|---|
| salaryStructure | salary-structure.id |  |
| totalEarning | salary-structure.totalEarning |  |

## Move

## Steps
