## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| StructureWithoutEarnings | 41 | SS-001 | declared in errors.ts |
| StructureComponentNotInCompany | 42 | SS-002 | declared in errors.ts, carrying salaryComponent |
| StructureComponentWrongType | 43 | SS-003 | declared in errors.ts, carrying salaryComponent |
| StructureLineWithoutAmount | 44 | SS-004 | declared in errors.ts, carrying salaryComponent |
| StructureComponentRepeated | 45 | SS-005 | declared in errors.ts, carrying salaryComponent |
| SalaryStructureNameTaken | 48 | SS-008 | another salary structure holds this company and salary structure name; by the rule salary-structure.oneNamePerCompany |
| NotAllowed | 3 | AR-001 | the caller isn't the owner of its company; the handler never runs |
| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### assign salary structures

Starts from the world `a payroll outsider`.

- **Ada drafts a second structure: Basic at its own 3,000.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, salaryStructureName `Leads`, earnings [{ salaryComponent: the world's basic, amount: `0` }], deductions [], and is answered.
- **and drafts a structure there.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, salaryStructureName `Drivers`, earnings [{ salaryComponent: the last call's salaryComponent, amount: `0` }], deductions [], and is answered.
- **Ada drafts a seniors' structure: Basic at 5,000.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, salaryStructureName `Seniors`, earnings [{ salaryComponent: the world's basic, amount: `5000000000` }], deductions [], and is answered.
- **Ada drafts a structure for temporary staff: Basic at its own 3,000.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, salaryStructureName `Temps`, earnings [{ salaryComponent: the world's basic, amount: `0` }], deductions [], and is answered.
- **Ada drafts an interim structure: Basic at its own 3,000.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, salaryStructureName `Interim`, earnings [{ salaryComponent: the world's basic, amount: `0` }], deductions [], and is answered.

### pay a month

Starts from the world `a pension component`.

- **Ada drafts the engineers' structure: Basic and Pension at their own amounts, Housing at 500 USDC.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, salaryStructureName `Engineers`, earnings [{ salaryComponent: the world's basic, amount: `0` }, { salaryComponent: the world's housing, amount: `500000000` }], deductions [{ salaryComponent: the world's pensionComponent, amount: `0` }], and gets back [`3500000000`, `150000000`, `3350000000`].

### run a payroll

Starts from the world `an outside cost center`.

- **Ada drafts a seniors' structure: Basic at 5,000, nothing deducted.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, salaryStructureName `Seniors`, earnings [{ salaryComponent: the world's basic, amount: `5000000000` }], deductions [], and is answered.
- **Ada drafts a structure paying nothing net: Basic at 150, less Pension at its own 150.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, salaryStructureName `Volunteers`, earnings [{ salaryComponent: the world's basic, amount: `150000000` }], deductions [{ salaryComponent: the world's pensionComponent, amount: `0` }], and is answered.

## Refusals

| refusal | exit | code | when |
|---|---|---|---|
| ShiftStartsWhenItEnds | 42 | SH-002 | declared in errors.ts |
| ShiftTypeNameTaken | 41 | SH-001 | another shift type holds this company and shift type name; by the rule shift-type.oneNamePerCompany, carrying shiftTypeName |

| IdempotencyConflict | 120 | AR-002 | the request key was first used with another payload; the handler never runs |

## Worked examples

### set up shift types

Starts from the world `three companies`.

- **Ada adds a day shift, nine to five.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Day`, startTime `09:00`, endTime `17:00`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **a night shift may end the morning after it starts.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Night`, startTime `22:00`, endTime `06:00`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **a shift can't start when it ends.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Nothing`, startTime `08:00`, endTime `08:00`, and is refused with ShiftStartsWhenItEnds, SH-002.
- **nor at midnight, when it ends at midnight.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Midnight`, startTime `00:00`, endTime `00:00`, and is refused with ShiftStartsWhenItEnds, SH-002.
- **a name already taken, with the same start and end, is refused for its times first.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Day`, startTime `07:30`, endTime `07:30`, and is refused with ShiftStartsWhenItEnds, SH-002.
- **a shift one minute long is allowed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Handover`, startTime `08:00`, endTime `08:01`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **a shift exactly twelve hours long is allowed, eight in the morning to eight at night.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Twelve`, startTime `08:00`, endTime `20:00`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **an evening shift may end at midnight.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Evening`, startTime `16:00`, endTime `00:00`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **a graveyard shift may start at midnight.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Graveyard`, startTime `00:00`, endTime `08:00`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **a sixteen-hour shift is allowed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Sixteen`, startTime `06:00`, endTime `22:00`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **and a fourteen-hour shift overnight.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Overnight`, startTime `18:00`, endTime `08:00`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **a name in lower case is kept as typed.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `late`, startTime `14:00`, endTime `22:00`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Day can't be added to Acme Trading twice.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Day`, startTime `08:00`, endTime `16:00`, and is refused with ShiftTypeNameTaken, SH-001, carrying shiftTypeName `Day`.
- **Bo can't add a shift to Ada's company.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends company the world's company, shiftTypeName `Early`, startTime `06:00`, endTime `14:00`, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **Acme Logistics may have a Day shift of its own, with other times.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, shiftTypeName `Day`, startTime `08:00`, endTime `16:30`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.
- **Bo adds a Day shift to Bo Ltd.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends company the world's boCompany, shiftTypeName `Day`, startTime `09:00`, endTime `17:00`, and gets back an answer matching `^sht_[0-9a-z]+$`.

## How to call

```sh
capxul shift-type create --company <company> --shiftTypeName <shiftTypeName> --startTime <startTime> --endTime <endTime>
```

HTTP: `POST /shift-type/create` with the payload as JSON. SDK: `Sdk.shift-type.create(payload)`.

### add customers and suppliers

Starts from the world `an outside supplier`.

- **Ada adds Acme Logistics' root supplier group.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, supplierGroupName `All Supplier Groups`, isGroup true, and gets back an answer matching `^sgr_`.

### set up party groups

Starts from the world `a supplier group`.

- **nor add a supplier group.** `bo` (signed in) calls and sends company the world's company, supplierGroupName `Raw Materials`, parentSupplierGroup the world's allSupplierGroups, isGroup false, and is refused with NotAllowed, AR-001.
- **a second root is refused, carrying the root.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, supplierGroupName `Vendors`, isGroup true, and is refused with SupplierGroupRootExists, SG-003, carrying root the world's allSupplierGroups.

- **a name already taken is refused.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, supplierGroupName `Services`, parentSupplierGroup the world's allSupplierGroups, isGroup false, and is refused with SupplierGroupNameTaken, SG-004.
- **a customer group's name is no supplier group's: it is free here.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, supplierGroupName `Commercial`, parentSupplierGroup the world's allSupplierGroups, isGroup false, and is answered.
- **Ada adds a supplier group that is a group, under the root.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, supplierGroupName `Utilities`, parentSupplierGroup the world's allSupplierGroups, isGroup true, and is answered.
- **and a ledger under it, two levels below the root.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's company, supplierGroupName `Water`, parentSupplierGroup the last call's supplierGroup, isGroup false, and is answered.
- **Acme Logistics may have its own root.** `ada` (role company.owner) calls and sends company the world's otherCompany, supplierGroupName `All Supplier Groups`, isGroup true, and is answered.
